scripts.title: Universal Script (BETA)
scripts.script:
--[[
    ========================================================
       [ KERNEL CORE // NEXUS CLIENT v11.7 ]
       Type 'help' in the console or use prefix '.'
       Type 'settings' or 'ezload' to open panels
    ========================================================
]]

print("[Nexus] Initializing kernel framework v11.7...")

-- Services
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local PlayerGui = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. CONFIGURATION & STATE TABLE
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local NexusConfig = {
    ESP_Enabled = true,
    Tracers_Enabled = true,
    Box_Enabled = true,
    TeamCheck = false,
    ESP_Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255),
}

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. GUI FRAMEWORK (HUD & DRAGGABLE MATRIX WINDOW)
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "Nexus_CoreUI"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

pcall(function()
    if gethui then
        screenGui.Parent = gethui()
    else
        screenGui.Parent = CoreGui
    end
end)
if not screenGui.Parent then
    screenGui.Parent = PlayerGui
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 3. ANIMATED LOADING SCREEN
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local loadScreen = Instance.new("Frame")
loadScreen.Name = "LoadingScreen"
loadScreen.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
loadScreen.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(5, 5, 8)
loadScreen.ZIndex = 100
loadScreen.Parent = screenGui

local loadBox = Instance.new("Frame")
loadBox.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)

loadBox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 320, 0, 120)
loadBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 14)
loadBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
loadBox.ZIndex = 101
loadBox.Parent = loadScreen

local lbCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
lbCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
lbCorner.Parent = loadBox

local lbStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
lbStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
lbStroke.Thickness = 1.5
lbStroke.Parent = loadBox

local loadTitle = Instance.new("TextLabel")
loadTitle.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
loadTitle.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 15)
loadTitle.BackgroundTransparency = 1
loadTitle.Font = Enum.Font.Code
loadTitle.TextSize = 15
loadTitle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
loadTitle.Text = "// LOADING NEXUS KERNEL..."
loadTitle.ZIndex = 102
loadTitle.Parent = loadBox

local barBg = Instance.new("Frame")
barBg.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 75)
barBg.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 6)
barBg.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30)
barBg.BorderSizePixel = 0
barBg.ZIndex = 102
barBg.Parent = loadBox

local barBgCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
barBgCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
barBgCorner.Parent = barBg

local loadFill = Instance.new("Frame")
loadFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
loadFill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
loadFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
loadFill.ZIndex = 103
loadFill.Parent = barBg

local fillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
fillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
fillCorner.Parent = loadFill

task.spawn(function()
    local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(1.2, Enum.EasingStyle.Quart, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
    TweenService:Create(loadFill, tweenInfo, {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)}):Play()
    task.wait(1.4)
    
    local fadeInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
    TweenService:Create(loadScreen, fadeInfo, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(loadBox, fadeInfo, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(lbStroke, fadeInfo, {Transparency = 1}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(loadTitle, fadeInfo, {TextTransparency = 1}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(barBg, fadeInfo, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
    TweenService:Create(loadFill, fadeInfo, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}):Play()
    task.wait(0.5)
    loadScreen:Destroy()
end)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 4. MAIN TERMINAL WINDOW FRAME
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

mainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
mainFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.35, 0)
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 620, 0, 380)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(10, 10, 12)
mainFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
mainFrame.Visible = true
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui

local uiCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
uiCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
uiCorner.Parent = mainFrame

local uiStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
uiStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
uiStroke.Thickness = 1.5
uiStroke.Transparency = 0.1
uiStroke.Parent = mainFrame

local titleBar = Instance.new("TextLabel")
titleBar.Name = "TitleBar"
titleBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)
titleBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 20, 26)
titleBar.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
titleBar.Font = Enum.Font.Code
titleBar.TextSize = 13
titleBar.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
titleBar.Text = "  // NEXUS KERNEL [STATUS: ACTIVE] - Press [DELETE] to Toggle"
titleBar.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
titleBar.Parent = mainFrame

local titleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
titleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
titleCorner.Parent = titleBar

-- Dragging Logic
local dragging, dragInput, dragStart, startPos
titleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPos = mainFrame.Position
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

titleBar.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
        dragInput = input
    end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if input == dragInput and dragging then
        local delta = input.Position - dragStart
        mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
    end
end)

-- Console Scroll Log
local scrollLog = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
scrollLog.Name = "ScrollLog"
scrollLog.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 45)
scrollLog.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -110)

logPadding.Parent = scrollLog

-- Command Input Field
local inputContainer = Instance.new("Frame")

inputContainer.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -55)
inputContainer.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 40)

inputContainer.Parent = mainFrame

local inputCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
inputCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
inputCorner.Parent = inputContainer

local inputStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
inputStroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)
inputStroke.Thickness = 1
inputStroke.Transparency = 0.5
inputStroke.Parent = inputContainer

local commandTextBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
commandTextBox.Name = "CommandInput"
commandTextBox.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, 0)
commandTextBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 0)
commandTextBox.BackgroundTransparency = 1
commandTextBox.Font = Enum.Font.Code
commandTextBox.TextSize = 13

commandTextBox.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 110)
commandTextBox.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
commandTextBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
commandTextBox.Parent = inputContainer

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 5. SETTINGS PANEL
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
local settingsFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
settingsFrame.Name = "SettingsPanel"
settingsFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
settingsFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)

local function createToggleSetting(labelName, initialValue, callback)
    local toggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
    toggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35)

-- Wallhop Macro State & Front-Facing Detection Loop
local wallhopActive = false
local wallhopConn = nil

addEzButton("Toggle Wallhop Macro", function()
    wallhopActive = not wallhopActive
    if wallhopActive then
        wallhopConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
            local char = LocalPlayer.Character
            if not char then return end
            local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if not hrp or not hum then return end

            local forwardPos = hrp.Position + (hrp.CFrame.LookVector * 3) + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
            local params = OverlapParams.new()
            params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {char}
            params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
            
            local scanCFrame = CFrame.new(forwardPos)
            local scanSize = Vector3.new(3, 4, 3)
            local frontParts = Workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(scanCFrame, scanSize, params)
            
            local stackedPartsCount = 0
            for _, part in ipairs(frontParts) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    stackedPartsCount = stackedPartsCount + 1
                end
            end

            if stackedPartsCount >= 2 then
                hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
                
                local targetCF = CFrame.new(hrp.Position, Vector3.new(frontParts[1].Position.X, hrp.Position.Y, frontParts[1].Position.Z))
                local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
                
                TweenService:Create(hrp, tweenInfo, {CFrame = targetCF}):Play()
                TweenService:Create(Camera, tweenInfo, {CFrame = Camera.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(math.random(-15, 15)), 0)}):Play()
            end
        end)
        print("[EzLoad]: Wallhop Macro ENABLED.")
    else
        if wallhopConn then
            wallhopConn:Disconnect()
            wallhopConn = nil

local espDrawings = {}

local function createESP(player)
    if espDrawings[player] then return end
    local drawings = {
        Box = Drawing.new("Square"),
        Tracer = Drawing.new("Line")
    }
    drawings.Box.Visible = false
    drawings.Box.Thickness = 1.5
    drawings.Box.Filled = false
    drawings.Tracer.Visible = false
    drawings.Tracer.Thickness = 1.5
    espDrawings[player] = drawings
end

local function removeESP(player)
    if espDrawings[player] then
        for _, drawing in pairs(espDrawings[player]) do
            drawing:Remove()
        end
        espDrawings[player] = nil
    end
end

            local char = player.Character

local function findPlayer(query)
    if not query or query == "" then return nil end
    query = string.lower(query)
    
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if string.lower(player.Name) == query or string.lower(player.DisplayName) == query then
            return player
        end
    end
    
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local nameLower = string.lower(player.Name)
        local displayLower = string.lower(player.DisplayName)
        if string.sub(nameLower, 1, #query) == query or string.sub(displayLower, 1, #query) == query then
            return player
        end
    end
    
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        local nameLower = string.lower(player.Name)
        local displayLower = string.lower(player.DisplayName)
        if string.find(nameLower, query, 1, true) or string.find(displayLower, query, 1, true) then
            return player
        end
    end
    
    return nil
end

local flying = false

local function startFly()
    local char = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not char then return end
    local hrp = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not hrp or not hum then return end

    if flying then stopFly() end
    flying = true
    hum.PlatformStand = true

    bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    bg.P = 9e4
    bg.maxTorque = Vector3.new(9e4, 9e4, 9e4)
    bg.cframe = hrp.CFrame
    bg.Parent = hrp

    bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bv.velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
    bv.maxForce = Vector3.new(9e4, 9e4, 9e4)
    bv.Parent = hrp

    flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        if not flying or not char or not hrp.Parent then return end
        local camCF = Camera.CFrame
        local moveDir = Vector3.new()

        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then
            moveDir = moveDir + camCF.LookVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then
            moveDir = moveDir - camCF.LookVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then
            moveDir = moveDir - camCF.RightVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then
            moveDir = moveDir + camCF.RightVector
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
            moveDir = moveDir + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end
        if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
            moveDir = moveDir - Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
        end

        bv.velocity = moveDir * flySpeed
        bg.cframe = camCF
    end)
    logMessage("Fly mode: ENABLED", Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120))
end

    flying = false
    if flyConnection then

        flyConnection = nil

    if LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
        LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").PlatformStand = false

    if bg then bg:Destroy() bg = nil end
    if bv then bv:Destroy() bv = nil end
    logMessage("Fly mode: DISABLED", Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50))

local __NA_SPLIT_SOURCE_TAG = "NA testing.lua"
local __NA_SPLIT_CONFIG = {

}

--!nonstrict

local __NARootHost = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G or {}
local __naPrev = type(__NARootHost) == "table" and rawget(__NARootHost, "_na_boot") or nil
if type(__naPrev) == "table" and rawget(__naPrev, "runtimeEnv") == __NARootHost and type(rawget(__naPrev, "hostEnv")) == "table" then
	__NARootHost = __naPrev.hostEnv
end
local __NARootPreviousNACaller = type(__NARootHost) == "table" and rawget(__NARootHost, "NACaller") or nil
local __NARootErrorState = type(__NARootHost) == "table" and rawget(__NARootHost, "__NAErrorLogState") or nil
if type(__NARootErrorState) ~= "table" then
	__NARootErrorState = { lastIndex = 0; rootCount = 0 }
	if type(__NARootHost) == "table" then
		pcall(rawset, __NARootHost, "__NAErrorLogState", __NARootErrorState)
	end
end

local function __NARootExecutorInfo()
	local name = "Unknown"
	local versionValue = "Unknown"
	if type(identifyexecutor) == "function" then
		local ok, a, b = pcall(identifyexecutor)
		if ok then
			if a ~= nil and tostring(a) ~= "" then name = tostring(a) end
			if b ~= nil and tostring(b) ~= "" then versionValue = tostring(b) end
		end
	end
	if name == "Unknown" and type(getexecutorname) == "function" then
		local ok, value = pcall(getexecutorname)
		if ok and value ~= nil and tostring(value) ~= "" then name = tostring(value) end
	end
	if versionValue == "Unknown" and type(getexecutorversion) == "function" then
		local ok, value = pcall(getexecutorversion)
		if ok and value ~= nil and tostring(value) ~= "" then versionValue = tostring(value) end
	end
	return name, versionValue
end

local function __NARootDebugInfo(fn)
	local source = "Unknown"
	local line = 0
	local name = "anonymous"
	if type(debug) == "table" and type(debug.info) == "function" and type(fn) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			local s, l, n = debug.info(fn, "sln")
			if s ~= nil and tostring(s) ~= "" then source = tostring(s) end
			if tonumber(l) then line = tonumber(l) end
			if n ~= nil and tostring(n) ~= "" then name = tostring(n) end
		end)
	end
	return source, line, name
end

local function __NARootNextErrorPath()
	local root = "Nameless-Admin"
	local dir = root.."/ErrorLogs"
	local maxIndex = tonumber(__NARootErrorState.lastIndex) or 0
	if type(makefolder) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			if type(isfolder) ~= "function" or not isfolder(root) then makefolder(root) end
		end)
		pcall(function()
			if type(isfolder) ~= "function" or not isfolder(dir) then makefolder(dir) end
		end)
	end
	if type(listfiles) == "function" then
		local ok, entries = pcall(listfiles, dir)
		if ok and type(entries) == "table" then
			for _, entry in entries do
				local normalized = tostring(entry):gsub("\\", "/")
				local index = tonumber(normalized:match("NA_Error#(%d+)%.txt$"))
				if index and index > maxIndex then maxIndex = index end
			end
		end
	end
	local nextIndex = maxIndex + 1
	local path = dir.."/NA_Error#"..tostring(nextIndex)..".txt"
	if type(isfile) == "function" then
		while isfile(path) do
			nextIndex += 1
			path = dir.."/NA_Error#"..tostring(nextIndex)..".txt"
		end
	end
	__NARootErrorState.lastIndex = nextIndex
	return path, nextIndex
end

local function __NARootReportError(rawError, tracebackText, context, fn, options)
	options = type(options) == "table" and options or {}
	__NARootErrorState.rootCount = (tonumber(__NARootErrorState.rootCount) or 0) + 1
	local logPath, fileIndex = __NARootNextErrorPath()
	local execName, execVersion = __NARootExecutorInfo()
	local fnSource, fnLine, fnName = __NARootDebugInfo(fn)
	local clientVersion = "Unknown"
	if type(version) == "function" then
		local ok, value = pcall(version)
		if ok and value ~= nil and tostring(value) ~= "" then clientVersion = tostring(value) end
	end
	local timestamp = tostring(os.time and os.time() or "Unknown")
	if type(os.date) == "function" then
		local ok, value = pcall(os.date, "!%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
		if ok and value then timestamp = tostring(value) end
	end
	local placeName = "Unknown"
	local placeId = "Unknown"
	local gameId = "Unknown"
	local jobId = "Unknown"
	pcall(function()
		placeName = tostring(game.Name or "Unknown")
		placeId = tostring(game.PlaceId or "Unknown")
		gameId = tostring(game.GameId or "Unknown")
		jobId = tostring(game.JobId or "Unknown")
	end)
	local platform = "Unknown"
	pcall(function()
		local uis = game:GetService("UserInputService")
		if uis and type(uis.GetPlatform) == "function" then
			platform = tostring(uis:GetPlatform())
		end
	end)
	local errorId = "NAE-ROOT-"..string.format("%06d", tonumber(fileIndex) or tonumber(__NARootErrorState.rootCount) or 1)
	local lines = {
		"[Nameless Admin Root Error Report]";
		"Error ID: "..errorId;
		"Error File: NA_Error#"..tostring(fileIndex or "Unknown")..".txt";
		"Time (UTC): "..timestamp;
		"Context: "..tostring(context or options.context or "Nameless Admin Main Runtime");
		"Severity: "..string.upper(tostring(options.severity or "fatal"));
		"";
		"Runtime";
		"Executor: "..execName;
		"Executor Version: "..execVersion;
		"Roblox Client: "..clientVersion;
		"Platform: "..platform;
		"NA Source: "..__NA_SPLIT_SOURCE_TAG;
		"Coverage: Root NACaller";
		"";
		"Session";
		"Place: "..placeName;
		"PlaceId: "..placeId;
		"GameId: "..gameId;
		"JobId: "..jobId;
		"";
		"Callback";
		"Function: "..fnName;
		"Defined At: "..fnSource..":"..tostring(fnLine);
		"";
		"Error";
		tostring(rawError or "Unknown error");
		"";
		"Traceback";
		tostring(tracebackText or rawError or "Unavailable");
	}
	if type(options.details) == "table" then
		lines[#lines + 1] = ""
		lines[#lines + 1] = "Additional Context"
		for key, value in options.details do
			lines[#lines + 1] = tostring(key)..": "..tostring(value)
		end
	end
	local report = table.concat(lines, "\n")
	local writer = type(writefile) == "function" and writefile or (type(appendfile) == "function" and appendfile or nil)
	local saved = false
	if options.log ~= false and type(writer) == "function" then
		pcall(function()
			writer(logPath, report.."\n")
			saved = true
		end)
	end
	if options.warn ~= false and type(warn) == "function" then
		pcall(warn, report..(saved and ("\nSaved: "..logPath) or ""))
	end
	return report, saved and logPath or nil, errorId
end

local function __NARootNACaller(fnOrOptions, ...)
	local options = {}
	local fn
	local args
	if type(fnOrOptions) == "table" and type(select(1, ...)) == "function" then
		for key, value in fnOrOptions do options[key] = value end
		fn = select(1, ...)
		args = table.pack(select(2, ...))
	else
		fn = fnOrOptions
		args = table.pack(...)
	end
	if type(fn) ~= "function" then
		local message = "NACaller expected a function, got "..type(fn)
		__NARootReportError(message, message, options.context or "NACaller bootstrap", nil, options)
		return false, message
	end
	local rawError
	local results = table.pack(xpcall(function()
		return fn(table.unpack(args, 1, args.n))
	end, function(message)
		rawError = tostring(message or "Unknown error")
		if type(debug) == "table" and type(debug.traceback) == "function" then
			local ok, trace = pcall(debug.traceback, rawError, 2)
			if ok and type(trace) == "string" and trace ~= "" then return trace end
		end
		return rawError
	end))
	if not results[1] then
		local trace = tostring(results[2] or rawError or "Unknown error")
		__NARootReportError(rawError or trace, trace, options.context or "Nameless Admin Main Runtime", fn, options)
		if options.rethrow == true then error(trace, 0) end
	end

local function __NA_SPLIT_PART_VALID(source, meta, name)
	if type(source) ~= "string" or source == "" then return false end
	local checks = type(meta) == "table" and meta.integrity or nil
	if checks == nil then return true end
	local check = type(checks) == "table" and checks[name] or nil
	if type(check) ~= "table" or #source ~= check[1] or type(check[2]) ~= "number" then return false end
	local a, b = 1, 0
	local nextYield = os.clock() + 0.004
	for start = 1, #source, 4096 do
		for index = start, math.min(start + 4095, #source) do
			a += string.byte(source, index)
			b += a
		end
		a %= 65521
		b %= 65521
		if start + 4095 < #source and os.clock() >= nextYield then
			__NA_SPLIT_YIELD()
			nextYield = os.clock() + 0.004
		end
	end
	return b * 65536 + a == check[2]
end

	local remoteName = sourceTag:gsub(" ", "%%20")
	local loaderRoot = __NA_SPLIT_REMOTE_ROOT:gsub("NA%-split/[^/]+/$", "")
	if loaderRoot == __NA_SPLIT_REMOTE_ROOT then return end
	local url = loaderRoot..remoteName.."?na_loader="..meta.loader_version
	local requestFn = type(host) == "table" and (rawget(host, "request") or rawget(host, "http_request")) or nil
	local synTable = type(host) == "table" and rawget(host, "syn") or nil
	if type(requestFn) ~= "function" and type(synTable) == "table" then
		requestFn = synTable.request
	end

	local source
	if type(requestFn) == "function" then
		local ok, response = pcall(requestFn, { Method = "GET"; Url = url; })
		local status = type(response) == "table" and tonumber(response.StatusCode or response.statusCode or response.Status) or nil
		local body = type(response) == "table" and (response.Body or response.body) or nil
		if ok and type(body) == "string" and body ~= "" and (not status or status < 400) then
			source = body
		end
	end

	if not source and (type(game) == "userdata" or type(game) == "table") then
		local ok, body = pcall(function()
			return game:HttpGet(url)
		end)
		if ok and type(body) == "string" and body ~= "" then
			source = body
		end
	end
	if not source then
		return
	end

	local loader = type(host) == "table" and rawget(host, "loadstring") or nil
	loader = loader or loadstring or load
	if type(loader) ~= "function" then
		return
	end
	local okCompile, chunk = pcall(loader, source, "@"..sourceTag)
	if not okCompile or type(chunk) ~= "function" then
		return
	end

	if type(makefolder) == "function" then
		local parent = root:gsub("/$", "")
		local current = ""
		for segment in parent:gmatch("[^/]+") do
			current = current == "" and segment or current.."/"..segment
			pcall(makefolder, current)
		end
	end
	if pcall(writefile, cachePath, source) then
		pcall(writefile, versionPath, meta.loader_version)
	end
end


local function __NA_SPLIT_CLEAR_LEGACY()
	if type(isfolder) ~= "function" or type(delfolder) ~= "function" then return 0 end
	local function clean(root, path, depth)
		if depth > 16 then return end
		local ok, exists = pcall(isfolder, path)
		if not ok or not exists then return end
		if type(listfiles) == "function" then
			local listed, items = pcall(listfiles, path)
			if listed and type(items) == "table" then
				for _, entry in items do
					local name = tostring(entry):gsub("\\", "/"):gsub("^%./", ""):gsub("/+$", "")
					if name:sub(1, #root + 1) == root.."/"
						and not name:find("/../", 1, true) and name:sub(-3) ~= "/.." then
						local valid, isDir = pcall(isfolder, name)
						if valid and isDir then
							clean(root, name, depth + 1)
						elseif type(delfile) == "function" then
							pcall(delfile, name)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		pcall(delfolder, path)
	end
	local removed = 0
	for _, root in { "NA-split", "Nameless-Admin/NA-split", "Nameless Admin/NA-split" } do
		local ok, exists = pcall(isfolder, root)
		if ok and exists then
			clean(root, root, 0)
			local checked, remains = pcall(isfolder, root)
			if checked and not remains then removed += 1 end
		end
	end
	return removed
end

local function __NA_SPLIT_MODULE_PATH(key)
	if type(key) ~= "string" or not key:match("^[%w_-]+$") then return nil end
	return __NA_SPLIT_CACHE_ROOT..".modules/"..key..".cache"
end

local function __NA_SPLIT_MODULE_SOURCE(data, url)
	if type(data) ~= "string" or type(url) ~= "string" or url == "" or url:find("[\r\n]") then return nil end
	local prefix = url.."\n"
	if data:sub(1, #prefix) ~= prefix then return nil end
	local source = data:sub(#prefix + 1)
	if source == "" then return nil end
	local loader = rawget(__NARootHost, "loadstring") or loadstring or load
	if type(loader) ~= "function" then return nil end
	local ok, chunk = pcall(loader, source, "@"..url)
	return ok and type(chunk) == "function" and source or nil
end

local function __NA_SPLIT_READ_MODULE(key, url)
	local path = __NA_SPLIT_MODULE_PATH(key)
	if not path or type(readfile) ~= "function" then return nil end
	local paths = {path, path..".backup"}
	for _, name in paths do
		local ok, data = pcall(readfile, name)
		local source = ok and __NA_SPLIT_MODULE_SOURCE(data, url)
		if source then return source end
	end
	return nil
end

local function __NA_SPLIT_SAVE_MODULE(key, url, source)
	local path = __NA_SPLIT_MODULE_PATH(key)
	if not path or type(readfile) ~= "function" or type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(source) ~= "string" then return false end
	if type(url) ~= "string" or url == "" or url:find("[\r\n]") then return false end
	local data = url.."\n"..source
	if not __NA_SPLIT_MODULE_SOURCE(data, url) then return false end
	local okOld, old = pcall(readfile, path)
	if okOld and old == data then return true end
	if type(makefolder) == "function" then
		local current = ""
		for segment in (__NA_SPLIT_CACHE_ROOT..".modules"):gmatch("[^/]+") do
			current = current == "" and segment or current.."/"..segment
			pcall(makefolder, current)
		end
	end
	if okOld and __NA_SPLIT_MODULE_SOURCE(old, url) then
		if not pcall(writefile, path..".backup", old) then return false end
		local okBackup, backup = pcall(readfile, path..".backup")
		if not okBackup or backup ~= old then return false end
	end
	if not pcall(writefile, path, data) then return false end
	local okRead, written = pcall(readfile, path)
	return okRead and written == data
end

local __NA_SPLIT_ENV
local __NA_LAZY_FILES = {}
local __NA_LAZY_ORDER = {}
local __NA_MODULE_REFRESH = {}

local __NA_SPLIT_DEFER

local function __NA_SPLIT_REMEMBER(name, source)
	if __NA_LAZY_FILES[name] then return end
	__NA_LAZY_FILES[name] = source
	__NA_LAZY_ORDER[#__NA_LAZY_ORDER + 1] = name
	while #__NA_LAZY_ORDER > 4 do
		__NA_LAZY_FILES[table.remove(__NA_LAZY_ORDER, 1)] = nil
	end
end

local function __NA_SPLIT_LAZY_SOURCE(name)
	if __NA_LAZY_FILES[name] then return __NA_LAZY_FILES[name] end
	local source = __NA_SPLIT_PENDING_CACHE[name]
	if not source then
		local meta = __NA_SPLIT_REMOTE_META or __NA_SPLIT_LOCAL_META
		if type(meta) ~= "table" then error("Missing common source manifest", 0) end
		source = __NA_SPLIT_READ_PART(name)
	end
	__NA_SPLIT_REMEMBER(name, source)
	return source
end

local function __NA_SPLIT_READ_DEFER()
	local meta = __NA_SPLIT_REMOTE_META or __NA_SPLIT_LOCAL_META
	if not __NA_SPLIT_LIMITED or not __NA_SPLIT_PART_FINGERPRINT(meta, "deferred.lua") then return end
	local ok, source = pcall(__NA_SPLIT_READ_PART, "deferred.lua")
	if not ok then return end
	local valid, chunk = pcall(__NA_SPLIT_LOAD_PART, source, "NA-split/common/deferred.lua", {})
	if not valid then return end
	local ran, data = pcall(chunk)
	if ran and type(data) == "table" then
		__NA_SPLIT_DEFER = data
		__NA_SPLIT_CACHE_PART("deferred.lua")
	end
end

local function __NA_SPLIT_PREPARE(source, name)
	local rows = __NA_SPLIT_DEFER and __NA_SPLIT_DEFER[name]
	if type(rows) ~= "table" or #rows == 0 then return source end
	local out, pos = {}, 1
	for _, row in rows do
		if type(row) ~= "table" then return source end
		local first, last, cut, line, prefix = table.unpack(row, 1, 5)
		if type(first) ~= "number" or type(last) ~= "number" or type(cut) ~= "number"
			or type(line) ~= "number" or type(prefix) ~= "string" or first < pos or last < first or last > #source
			or first % 1 ~= 0 or last % 1 ~= 0 or cut % 1 ~= 0 or line % 1 ~= 0
			or (cut ~= 0 and (cut < first or cut > last)) then return source end
		out[#out + 1] = source:sub(pos, first - 1)
		local label = "NA-split/common/"..name..":"..tostring(line)
		out[#out + 1] = prefix.."__NA_SPLIT_LAZY("..string.format("%q, %d, %d, %d, %q", name, first, last, cut, label)..")"
		pos = last + 1
	end
	out[#out + 1] = source:sub(pos)
	__NA_SPLIT_REMEMBER(name, source)
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function __NA_SPLIT_LAZY(name, first, last, cut, label)
	local fn, busy
	return function(...)
		while busy and coroutine.status(busy) ~= "dead" do task.wait() end
		if not fn then
			busy = coroutine.running()
			local ok, result = pcall(function()
				local source = __NA_SPLIT_LAZY_SOURCE(name)
				local body = cut > 0 and "function"..source:sub(cut, last) or source:sub(first, last)
				local env = __NA_SPLIT_ENV
				local boot = type(env) == "table" and rawget(env, "_na_boot")
				env = type(boot) == "table" and boot.runtimeEnv or env
				local chunk = __NA_SPLIT_LOAD_PART("return "..body, label, env)
				local value = chunk()
				if type(value) ~= "function" then error("Invalid deferred function: "..label, 0) end
				return value
			end)
			busy = nil
			if not ok then error(result, 0) end
			fn = result
		end
		return fn(...)
	end
end

local function __NA_SPLIT_QUEUE_REFRESH(key, url, fetch)
	if type(fetch) == "function" then
		__NA_MODULE_REFRESH[key] = {url = url, fetch = fetch}
	end
end

local function __NA_SPLIT_REFRESH_MODULES()
	if not __NA_SPLIT_LIMITED or not __NA_SPLIT_REMOTE_META or type(task.spawn) ~= "function" then return end
	task.spawn(function()
		for key, record in __NA_MODULE_REFRESH do
			if not __NA_SPLIT_OWNS() then break end
			local ok, source = pcall(record.fetch)
			if ok and type(source) == "string" and __NA_SPLIT_OWNS() then
				pcall(__NA_SPLIT_SAVE_MODULE, key, record.url, source)
			end
			__NA_MODULE_REFRESH[key] = nil
			task.wait()
		end
		table.clear(__NA_MODULE_REFRESH)
	end)
end

local function __NA_SPLIT_RUN()
	__NA_SPLIT_READ_DEFER()
	__NA_SPLIT_CONFIG.state = __NA_GLOBAL_STATE
	__NA_SPLIT_CONFIG.privateRoot = __NA_GLOBAL_ENV
	__NA_SPLIT_CONFIG.privateRegistry = __NA_SPLIT_REG
	__NA_SPLIT_CONFIG.cacheRoot = __NA_SPLIT_CACHE_ROOT
	__NA_SPLIT_CONFIG.offline = __NA_SPLIT_REMOTE_META == nil
	__NA_SPLIT_CONFIG.fastStart = __NA_SPLIT_LIMITED
	__NA_SPLIT_CONFIG.moduleRefresh = __NA_SPLIT_QUEUE_REFRESH
	__NA_SPLIT_CONFIG.moduleRead = __NA_SPLIT_READ_MODULE
	__NA_SPLIT_CONFIG.moduleWrite = __NA_SPLIT_SAVE_MODULE
	local environment = setmetatable({
		__NA_SPLIT_CONFIG = __NA_SPLIT_CONFIG;
		__NA_SPLIT_LAZY = __NA_SPLIT_LAZY;
		NACaller = __NARootNACaller;
		__NARootHost = __NARootHost;
		__NARootPreviousNACaller = __NARootPreviousNACaller;
		__NARootErrorState = __NARootErrorState;
		__NARootExecutorInfo = __NARootExecutorInfo;
		__NARootDebugInfo = __NARootDebugInfo;
		__NARootNextErrorPath = __NARootNextErrorPath;
		__NARootReportError = __NARootReportError;
		__NARootNACaller = __NARootNACaller;
	}, {
		__index = function(target, key)
			local boot = rawget(target, "_na_boot")
			local runtime = type(boot) == "table" and boot.runtimeEnv
			if type(runtime) == "table" then
				local value = rawget(runtime, key)
				if value ~= nil then
					return value
				end
			end
			return __NARootHost[key]
		end;
		__newindex = function(target, key, value)
			local boot = rawget(target, "_na_boot")
			local runtime = type(boot) == "table" and boot.runtimeEnv
			if type(runtime) == "table" and key ~= "_na_boot" and key ~= "_na_env" and key ~= "_na_shared" then
				rawset(runtime, key, value)
			else
				rawset(target, key, value)
			end
		end;
	})
	__NA_SPLIT_ENV = environment
	for index = 1, __NA_SPLIT_COUNT do
		if not __NA_SPLIT_OWNS() then
			error("Nameless Admin loading was cancelled", 0)
		end
		local partName = string.format("part-%03d.lua", index)
		__NA_GLOBAL_STATE.details.stage = partName
		__NA_GLOBAL_STATE.details.fingerprint = __NA_SPLIT_PART_FINGERPRINT(__NA_SPLIT_REMOTE_META or __NA_SPLIT_LOCAL_META, partName)
		__NA_SPLIT_SET_STAGE(partName)
		local source = __NA_SPLIT_READ_PART(partName)
		if not __NA_SPLIT_OWNS() then error("Nameless Admin loading was cancelled", 0) end
		local chunk = __NA_SPLIT_LOAD_PART(__NA_SPLIT_PREPARE(source, partName), "NA-split/common/"..partName, environment)
		local okRun, runError = xpcall(chunk, __NA_SPLIT_FORMAT_ERROR)
		chunk = nil
		source = nil
		if not okRun then
			error(__NA_SPLIT_FORMAT_ERROR(runError), 0)
		end
		if index == 1 then
			if runError == "__NA_SPLIT_DUPLICATE" then
				__NA_SPLIT_CONFIG.duplicate = true
				__NA_SPLIT_ENV = nil
				return
			end
			local boot = rawget(environment, "_na_boot")
			if type(boot) ~= "table" or type(boot.runtimeEnv) ~= "table" then
				error("Nameless Admin split bootstrap did not initialize", 0)
			end
			local migrated = {}
			for key, value in environment do
				if key ~= "__NA_SPLIT_CONFIG" and key ~= "NACaller" and key ~= "_na_boot" and key ~= "_na_env" and key ~= "_na_shared" then
					migrated[key] = value
				end
			end
			for key, value in migrated do
				rawset(boot.runtimeEnv, key, value)
				rawset(environment, key, nil)
			end
			environment = boot.runtimeEnv
			__NA_SPLIT_ENV = environment
		end
		__NA_SPLIT_CACHE_PART(partName)
		__NA_SPLIT_YIELD()
	end
	if not __NA_SPLIT_OWNS() then
		error("Nameless Admin loading was cancelled", 0)
	end
	__NA_SPLIT_SET_STAGE("cache")
	__NA_GLOBAL_STATE.details.stage = "cache"
	__NA_SPLIT_CACHE_REMOTE()
	pcall(__NA_SPLIT_CACHE_LOADER, __NA_SPLIT_REMOTE_META or __NA_SPLIT_LOCAL_META)
	local saved = __NA_SPLIT_LOAD_MANIFEST(__NA_SPLIT_READ_LOCAL(__NA_SPLIT_CACHE_ROOT, "manifest.lua"), __NA_SPLIT_CACHE_ROOT.."manifest.lua")
	local expected = __NA_SPLIT_REMOTE_META or __NA_SPLIT_LOCAL_META
	if __NA_SPLIT_CACHE_OK and saved and expected and saved.version == expected.version then
		pcall(__NA_SPLIT_CLEAR_LEGACY)
	end
end

local function __NA_SPLIT_ABORT()
	if not __NA_SPLIT_OWNS() then return end
	local environment = __NA_SPLIT_ENV
	if type(environment) ~= "table" then return end
	local boot = rawget(environment, "_na_boot")
	if type(boot) == "table" and type(boot.splitConfig) == "table" and boot.splitConfig.state ~= __NA_GLOBAL_STATE then return end
	local runtime = type(boot) == "table" and boot.runtimeEnv or environment
	local manage = rawget(runtime, "NAmanage")
	local unload = type(manage) == "table" and rawget(manage, "Unload")
	if type(unload) == "function" then
		local ok, done = pcall(unload, { silent = true })
		if ok and done ~= false then return end
	end
	if type(manage) == "table" and type(manage._runtimeState) == "table" then
		manage._runtimeState.unloading = true
		manage._runtimeState.runToken = nil
	end
	local seen = {}
	local current = coroutine.running()
	local function cancel(thread)
		if type(manage) == "table" and type(manage.CancelRuntimeTask) == "function" then
			pcall(manage.CancelRuntimeTask, thread)
		elseif type(task) == "table" then
			pcall(task.cancel, thread)
		end
	end
	local function clean(value)
		if type(value) ~= "table" or seen[value] then return end
		if type(boot) == "table" and (value == boot or value == boot.hostEnv
			or value == boot.privateRegistry or value == boot.privateRoot or value == runtime) then return end
		seen[value] = true
		if rawget(value, "Connected") ~= nil and type(rawget(value, "Disconnect")) == "function" then
			pcall(rawget(value, "Disconnect"), value)
		end
		for key, child in next, value do
			if typeof(child) == "RBXScriptConnection" then
				pcall(function() child:Disconnect() end)
			elseif type(child) == "thread" and child ~= current and coroutine.status(child) ~= "dead" and type(task) == "table" then
				cancel(child)
			elseif type(child) == "table" then
				clean(child)
			end
			if type(key) == "thread" and key ~= current and coroutine.status(key) ~= "dead" and type(task) == "table" then cancel(key) end
		end
	end
	for _, name in { "NAmanage", "NAStuff", "NAjobs", "NAgui", "NAUIMANAGER", "NAindex", "NAAssetsLoading" } do clean(rawget(runtime, name)) end
	local stuff = rawget(runtime, "NAStuff")
	if type(stuff) == "table" and typeof(stuff.NASCREENGUI) == "Instance" then
		pcall(function() stuff.NASCREENGUI:Destroy() end)
	end
	local assets = rawget(runtime, "NAAssetsLoading")
	if type(assets) == "table" and typeof(assets.ui) == "Instance" then
		pcall(function() assets.ui:Destroy() end)
	end
	if type(boot) == "table" and type(boot.privateRoot) == "table" then
		local root = boot.privateRoot
		local owned = rawget(runtime, "_na_env")
		local ownsRoot = type(owned) == "table" and root.testing == owned
		local protector = rawget(runtime, "__NAUIProtector")
		if type(protector) ~= "table" and ownsRoot then protector = root.uiProtector end
		if type(protector) == "table" and (ownsRoot or root.uiProtector ~= protector) then
			if type(protector.destroy) == "function" then pcall(protector.destroy) end
			if root.uiProtector == protector then root.uiProtector = nil end
		end
		if ownsRoot then
			root.testing = nil
			root.naRuns = nil
		end
	end
end

__NA_GLOBAL_STATE.details = {
	stage = "manifest";
	session = tostring(game.PlaceId).."_"..tostring(game.JobId);
	build = (__NA_SPLIT_REMOTE_META and __NA_SPLIT_REMOTE_META.version) or (__NA_SPLIT_LOCAL_META and __NA_SPLIT_LOCAL_META.version) or "unknown";
}

local __NARootResult = table.pack(__NARootNACaller({
	context = "Nameless Admin Main Runtime";
	details = __NA_GLOBAL_STATE.details;
	severity = "fatal";
	warn = true;
	log = true;
}, __NA_SPLIT_RUN))

if not __NARootResult[1] then pcall(__NA_SPLIT_ABORT) end

if (not __NARootResult[1] or __NA_SPLIT_CONFIG.duplicate) and type(__NARootHost) == "table"
	and rawget(__NARootHost, "NACaller") == __NARootNACaller then
	pcall(function()
		if __NARootPreviousNACaller ~= nil then
			rawset(__NARootHost, "NACaller", __NARootPreviousNACaller)
		else
			rawset(__NARootHost, "NACaller", nil)
		end
	end)
end

if __NARootResult[1] then
	__NA_SPLIT_RELEASE(not __NA_SPLIT_CONFIG.duplicate)
	if not __NA_SPLIT_CONFIG.duplicate then __NA_SPLIT_REFRESH_MODULES() end
	return table.unpack(__NARootResult, 2, __NARootResult.n)
end

__NA_SPLIT_RELEASE(false)

local function IsEnemy(character)
    if not character or character == LocalPlayer.Character then return false end
    local outline = character:FindFirstChild("TR_EnemyOutline")
        or character:FindFirstChild("TR_EnemyOutline", true)
    return outline ~= nil
end

local function IsVisible(targetPart, character)
    if CFG.WallbangEnabled then return true end
    if not CFG.WallCheck then return true end

    local origin    = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local direction = targetPart.Position - origin

    local params = RaycastParams.new()
    params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude

    local ignore = { LocalPlayer.Character, character, Camera }
    local fxF = Workspace:FindFirstChild("FX")
    if fxF then table.insert(ignore, fxF) end
    local prF = Workspace:FindFirstChild("Projectiles")
    if prF then table.insert(ignore, prF) end
    params.FilterDescendantsInstances = ignore

    return Workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, params) == nil
end

local function ResolvePartName()
    if CFG.TargetPart == "Random" then
        local opts = {"Head", "HumanoidRootPart", "UpperTorso"}
        return opts[math.random(1, #opts)]
    end
    return CFG.TargetPart
end

local function GetClosestTarget()
    local best     = nil
    local bestDist = CFG.FOVRadius
    local mPos     = Vector2.new(Mouse.X, Mouse.Y)
    local myRoot   = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return nil end

    local candidates = {}

    for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
            table.insert(candidates, {char = p.Character, player = p})
        end
    end

    for _, m in pairs(Workspace:GetChildren()) do
        if m:IsA("Model") and m ~= LocalPlayer.Character then
            if not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m) then
                if m:FindFirstChild("TR_EnemyOutline") or m:FindFirstChild("TR_EnemyOutline", true) then
                    table.insert(candidates, {char = m, player = nil})
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for _, c in pairs(candidates) do
        local char = c.char
        if IsEnemy(char) then
            local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                local partName = ResolvePartName()
                local part = char:FindFirstChild(partName)
                    or char:FindFirstChild("Head")
                    or char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    local dist3D = (part.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
                    if dist3D <= CFG.MaxDistance then
                        local sPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                        if onScreen then
                            local d2 = (Vector2.new(sPos.X, sPos.Y) - mPos).Magnitude
                            if d2 < bestDist and IsVisible(part, char) then
                                bestDist = d2
                                best = {
                                    Player    = c.player,
                                    Character = char,
                                    Part      = part,
                                    PartName  = partName,
                                    ScreenPos = sPos,
                                    Distance  = math.floor(dist3D),
                                }
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return best
end

    oldNamecall = hookmetamethod(game, "__namecall", newcclosure(function(self, ...)
        local method = getnamecallmethod()
        local args   = {...}

        if method == "FireServer" and self == WeaponAction then
            if CFG.SilentEnabled and CurrentTarget and RollHit() then
                local action = args[1]
                if action == "Shoot" and type(args[2]) == "table" then
                    local data = args[2]
                    if typeof(data.origin) == "Vector3" and typeof(data.dir) == "Vector3" then
                        local tPos   = CurrentTarget.Part.Position
                        data.dir     = (tPos - data.origin).Unit
                        args[2]      = data
                        return oldNamecall(self, unpack(args))
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        return oldNamecall(self, ...)
    end))
end

        if not character then return end
        task.spawn(function()
            local head = character:WaitForChild("Head", 5)
            local hum  = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
            if not head or not hum then return end

            local waited = 0
            while waited < 10 do

                task.wait(0.5)
                waited += 0.5
            end

            if not CFG.ESPEnabled then return end

            local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")

            lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
            lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)

            lbl.TextStrokeColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
            lbl.TextSize = 14
            lbl.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold

            end)
            character.Destroying:Connect(function() if bb then bb:Destroy() end end)
        end)

    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(Apply)
end

--// SERVICES
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")

--// CHILL MUSIC PLAYLIST (Roblox Sound IDs)
local chillPlaylist = {
    "rbxassetid://1837879082",  -- Chill Lofi 1
    "rbxassetid://1839841807",  -- Chill Lofi 2
    "rbxassetid://9043887091",  -- Ambient Chill
    "rbxassetid://9042539129",  -- Relaxing Beats
    "rbxassetid://1845341258",  -- Smooth Vibe
    "rbxassetid://1848354536"   -- Soft Aesthetic
}

-- Create a dedicated Sound instance
local musicSound = Instance.new("Sound")
musicSound.Name = "BackgroundChillMusic"
musicSound.Volume = 0.5
musicSound.Looped = false
musicSound.Parent = SoundService

local remainingPlaylist = {}

-- Function to shuffle table randomly (Fisher-Yates Shuffle)
local function shufflePlaylist()
    remainingPlaylist = {}
    for _, soundId in ipairs(chillPlaylist) do
        table.insert(remainingPlaylist, soundId)
    end
    
    for i = #remainingPlaylist, 2, -1 do
        local j = math.random(i)
        remainingPlaylist[i], remainingPlaylist[j] = remainingPlaylist[j], remainingPlaylist[i]
    end
    print("[Music Player] Playlist shuffled. " .. tostring(#remainingPlaylist) .. " tracks loaded.")
end

-- Function to play next unique song
local function playNextSong()
    -- Refill and shuffle if playlist is empty or all tracks played
    if #remainingPlaylist == 0 then
        shufflePlaylist()
    end
    
    -- Pick the top track and remove it from the pool to prevent repeats
    local nextTrack = table.remove(remainingPlaylist, 1)
    
    musicSound.SoundId = nextTrack
    musicSound:Play()
    print("[Music Player] Now playing: " .. nextTrack)
end

-- Play next track automatically when the current one ends
musicSound.Ended:Connect(playNextSong)

-- Start the music player
playNextSong()

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- ULTIMATE ENVIRONMENTAL SYSTEM v6.3 
-- (SHADERS + MOTION BLUR + FIREFLIES + DUST)
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

-- 1. ОЧИСТКА (Удаляем всё старое, включая лужи из прошлой версии)
for _, obj in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
    if obj.Name:match("Shader_") then obj:Destroy() end
end
local oldFX = Workspace:FindFirstChild("EnvironmentFX")
if oldFX then oldFX:Destroy() end
local oldPuddles = Workspace:FindFirstChild("PuddleFolder")
if oldPuddles then oldPuddles:Destroy() end
local oldGrass = Workspace:FindFirstChild("InteractiveGrass")
if oldGrass then oldGrass:Destroy() end

local FXFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
FXFolder.Name = "EnvironmentFX"
FXFolder.Parent = Workspace

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- 2. УБИЙЦА РАЗМЫТИЯ (Не трогает Motion Blur)
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        task.wait(0.5)
        for _, obj in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
            if obj:IsA("BlurEffect") and obj.Name ~= "Shader_MotionBlur" then 
                obj.Size = 0
            elseif obj:IsA("DepthOfFieldEffect") then
                obj.FarIntensity = 0; obj.NearIntensity = 0; obj.FocusDistance = 1000
            end
        end
    end
end)

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- 3. СОЗДАНИЕ ЭФФЕКТОВ
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local CC = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect"); CC.Name = "Shader_CC"; CC.Parent = Lighting
local Bloom = Instance.new("BloomEffect"); Bloom.Name = "Shader_Bloom"; Bloom.Parent = Lighting
local SunRays = Instance.new("SunRaysEffect"); SunRays.Name = "Shader_SunRays"; SunRays.Parent = Lighting
local Atmos = Instance.new("Atmosphere"); Atmos.Name = "Shader_Atmosphere"; Atmos.Parent = Lighting

local MotionBlur = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
MotionBlur.Name = "Shader_MotionBlur"
MotionBlur.Size = 0 
MotionBlur.Parent = Lighting

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- 4. ПРОФИЛИ ПОГОДЫ
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local NightProfile = {
    CC = {Brightness = 0.15, Contrast = 0.3, Saturation = -0.4, TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(100, 150, 255)},
    Bloom = {Intensity = 2, Size = 24, Threshold = 0.8},
    SunRays = {Intensity = 0.0, Spread = 0.1},
    Atmos = {Density = 0.2, Offset = 0.1, Color = Color3.fromRGB(30, 40, 60), Decay = Color3.fromRGB(10, 15, 30), Glare = 0, Haze = 0.5}, 
    LightingProps = {
        Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(80, 90, 130),        
        OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(90, 100, 140), 
        Brightness = 2.5,                              
        ShadowSoftness = 0.5
    },
    FOV = 65 
}

local DayProfile = {
    CC = {Brightness = 0.2, Contrast = 0.2, Saturation = 0.5, TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 150)}, 
    Bloom = {Intensity = 2, Size = 30, Threshold = 1}, 
    SunRays = {Intensity = 0.3, Spread = 0.5},
    Atmos = {Density = 0.25, Offset = 0.5, Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 100), Decay = Color3.fromRGB(200, 150, 50), Glare = 0.5, Haze = 2}, 
    LightingProps = {
        Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(120, 100, 80),
        OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(180, 150, 120),
        Brightness = 3.5,
        ShadowSoftness = 0.1
    },
    FOV = 80 
}

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- 5. ЛОГИКА ПЕРЕХОДА
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local isNight = false
local currentState = "None"

local function ApplyProfile(profile, transitionTime)
    local tInfo = TweenInfo.new(transitionTime, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut)
    TweenService:Create(CC, tInfo, profile.CC):Play()
    TweenService:Create(Bloom, tInfo, profile.Bloom):Play()
    TweenService:Create(SunRays, tInfo, profile.SunRays):Play()
    TweenService:Create(Atmos, tInfo, profile.Atmos):Play()
    TweenService:Create(Lighting, tInfo, profile.LightingProps):Play()
    TweenService:Create(Camera, tInfo, {FieldOfView = profile.FOV}):Play()
end

local initialTime = Lighting.ClockTime
if initialTime >= 18 or initialTime < 6 then
    isNight = true; currentState = "Night"; ApplyProfile(NightProfile, 0)
else
    isNight = false; currentState = "Day"; ApplyProfile(DayProfile, 0)
end

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- 6. ЖУКИ И ПЫЛЬ
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
local function SpawnFirefly()
    local part = Instance.new("Part")
    part.Name = "Firefly"
    part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    part.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
    part.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
    part.Color = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
    part.Anchored = true
    part.CanCollide = false
    part.Parent = FXFolder

    local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
    light.Color = part.Color
    light.Range = 12
    light.Brightness = 4 
    light.Shadows = true
    light.Parent = part

    local rootPart = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local basePos = rootPart and rootPart.Position or Camera.CFrame.Position
    part.Position = basePos + Vector3.new(math.random(-30, 30), math.random(-5, 10), math.random(-30, 30))

    local startTime = tick()
    local basePosition = part.Position
    
    local connection
    connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not part.Parent then connection:Disconnect() return end
        if rootPart then
            local dist = (part.Position - rootPart.Position).Magnitude
            if dist < 10 then
                local dir = (part.Position - rootPart.Position).Unit
                basePosition = basePosition + dir * 2
            end
        end
        local timePassed = tick() - startTime
        local xOff = math.sin(timePassed * 2) * 5
        local yOff = math.cos(timePassed * 3) * 2 + math.sin(timePassed * 1) * 1
        local zOff = math.cos(timePassed * 2) * 5
        part.CFrame = CFrame.new(basePosition + Vector3.new(xOff, yOff, zOff))
    end)

    task.delay(math.random(15, 25), function()
        connection:Disconnect()
        if part and part.Parent then
            TweenService:Create(part, TweenInfo.new(2), {Transparency = 1}):Play()
            task.wait(2)
            part:Destroy()
        end
    end)
end

local function SpawnDust()
    local rootPart = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not rootPart then return end

    local spawnPos = rootPart.Position + Vector3.new(math.random(-40, 40), math.random(30, 50), math.random(-40, 40))
    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {FXFolder, LocalPlayer.Character}
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    local rayResult = Workspace:Raycast(spawnPos, Vector3.new(0, -100, 0), raycastParams)
    
    if rayResult then
        local dust = Instance.new("Part")
        dust.Name = "Dust"
        dust.Size = Vector3.new(0.15, 0.15, 0.15)
        dust.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
        dust.Material = Enum.Material.Neon 
        dust.Anchored = true
        dust.CanCollide = false
        dust.Transparency = 0.5
        dust.CFrame = CFrame.new(spawnPos)
        dust.Parent = FXFolder

        local fallDistance = (spawnPos - rayResult.Position).Magnitude
        local fallTween = TweenService:Create(dust, TweenInfo.new(fallDistance / 15, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
            CFrame = CFrame.new(rayResult.Position + Vector3.new(0, 0.05, 0))
        })
        fallTween:Play()

        fallTween.Completed:Connect(function()
            if dust and dust.Parent then
                local sparkles = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
                sparkles.Texture = "rbxassetid://241629851"
                sparkles.Rate = 30 
                sparkles.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(0.5, 1)
                sparkles.Speed = NumberRange.new(2, 5)
                sparkles.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(180, 180)
                sparkles.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.3)
                sparkles.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(200, 255, 200))
                sparkles.LightEmission = 1
                sparkles.Parent = dust
                
                task.wait(5)
                if dust and dust.Parent then
                    sparkles.Rate = 0 
                    TweenService:Create(dust, TweenInfo.new(2, Enum.EasingStyle.Sine), {Transparency = 1}):Play()
                    task.wait(2)
                    if dust then dust:Destroy() end
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end

-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
-- 7. ГЛАВНЫЕ ЦИКЛЫ
-- ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
task.spawn(function()
    while true do
        local currentBugs = 0
        for _, v in ipairs(FXFolder:GetChildren()) do
            if v.Name == "Firefly" then currentBugs = currentBugs + 1 end
        end
        if currentState == "Night" and currentBugs < 15 then SpawnFirefly() end
        if currentState ~= "Night" then
            for _, v in ipairs(FXFolder:GetChildren()) do
                if v.Name == "Firefly" then v:Destroy() end
            end

        task.wait(math.random(1, 2))

end)

task.spawn(function()

        SpawnDust()
        task.wait(math.random(1, 2))
    end
end)

local timeAccum = 0
local lastCamCFrame = Camera.CFrame
local currentBlur = 0

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(deltaTime)
    timeAccum = timeAccum + deltaTime
    
    -- MOTION BLUR
    local currentCamCFrame = Camera.CFrame
    local posDelta = (currentCamCFrame.Position - lastCamCFrame.Position).Magnitude
    local rotDelta = (currentCamCFrame.LookVector - lastCamCFrame.LookVector).Magnitude
    local speed = posDelta + (rotDelta * 15)
    lastCamCFrame = currentCamCFrame
    
    local targetBlur = math.clamp(speed * 4, 0, 12)
    currentBlur = currentBlur + (targetBlur - currentBlur) * 0.15

    -- Проверка Дня/Ночи
    local clock = Lighting.ClockTime
    local shouldBeNight = (clock >= 18 or clock < 6)
    
    if shouldBeNight ~= isNight then
        isNight = shouldBeNight
        if isNight then currentState = "Night"; ApplyProfile(NightProfile, 7) 
        else currentState = "Day"; ApplyProfile(DayProfile, 7) end

    if currentState == "Night" then

        Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame * CFrame.new(shake, shake, 0)
    elseif currentState == "Day" then
        SunRays.Intensity = DayProfile.SunRays.Intensity + math.sin(timeAccum * 2) * 0.15
        Bloom.Intensity = DayProfile.Bloom.Intensity + math.cos(timeAccum * 1.5) * 0.5

local function rememberOriginalOutfit(char)
	if originalOutfits[char] then return end
	local shirt = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Shirt")
	local pants = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Pants")
	originalOutfits[char] = {
		shirtObject = shirt,
		shirtTemplate = shirt and shirt.ShirtTemplate or nil,
		pantsObject = pants,
		pantsTemplate = pants and pants.PantsTemplate or nil,
	}
end

local function applyOutfit(char)
	if not char or not char.Parent then return end
	local suit = SUITS[selectedSuit]
	if not suit or suit.Shirt == "" or suit.Pants == "" then return end
	rememberOriginalOutfit(char)
	local shirt = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Shirt")
	if not shirt then
		shirt = Instance.new("Shirt")
		shirt.Parent = char
	end
	shirt.ShirtTemplate = suit.Shirt
	local pants = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Pants")
	if not pants then
		pants = Instance.new("Pants")
		pants.Parent = char
	end
	pants.PantsTemplate = suit.Pants
end

local function removeOutfit(char)
	if not char then return end
	local original = originalOutfits[char]
	if not original then
		outfitEnabled = false
		return
	end
	local currentShirt = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Shirt")
	if original.shirtObject then
		if original.shirtObject.Parent ~= char then
			original.shirtObject.Parent = char
		end
		original.shirtObject.ShirtTemplate = original.shirtTemplate or ""
		if currentShirt and currentShirt ~= original.shirtObject then
			currentShirt:Destroy()
		end
	elseif currentShirt then
		currentShirt:Destroy()
	end
	local currentPants = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Pants")
	if original.pantsObject then
		if original.pantsObject.Parent ~= char then
			original.pantsObject.Parent = char
		end
		original.pantsObject.PantsTemplate = original.pantsTemplate or ""
		if currentPants and currentPants ~= original.pantsObject then
			currentPants:Destroy()
		end
	elseif currentPants then
		currentPants:Destroy()
	end
	outfitEnabled = false
end

local function getParts()
	local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	local hrp = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")

end

local function getAnimator(hum)
	local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
	if not animator then
		animator = Instance.new("Animator")
		animator.Parent = hum
	end
	return animator
end

local function getHand(char, side)
	if side == "Right" then
		return char:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or char:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
	end
	return char:FindFirstChild("LeftHand") or char:FindFirstChild("Left Arm")
end

local function getArmRoot(char, side)
	if side == "Right" then
		return char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperArm") or char:FindFirstChild("Right Arm") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
	end
	return char:FindFirstChild("LeftUpperArm") or char:FindFirstChild("Left Arm") or char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
end

local function findMotor(char, name)
	local motor = char:FindFirstChild(name, true)
	if motor and motor:IsA("Motor6D") then return motor end
	return nil
end

local function setMotor(char, name, cf)
	local motor = findMotor(char, name)
	if motor then motor.Transform = cf end
end

local function resetArmPose(char)
	if not char then return end
	local names = {
		"RightShoulder", "LeftShoulder", "RightElbow", "LeftElbow",
		"RightWrist", "LeftWrist", "Waist", "Neck",
		"RightHip", "LeftHip", "RightKnee", "LeftKnee",
		"RightAnkle", "LeftAnkle",
	}
	for _, name in ipairs(names) do
		setMotor(char, name, CFrame.identity)
	end
end

local function addWebFromHand(char, targetAtt, side)
	local hand = getHand(char, side)
	if not hand or not targetAtt then return end
	local handAtt = Instance.new("Attachment")
	handAtt.Name = "WebHandAttachment"
	handAtt.Parent = hand
	local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
	beam.Attachment0 = targetAtt
	beam.Attachment1 = handAtt
	beam.Width0 = 0.92
	beam.Width1 = 0.72
	beam.Texture = "rbxassetid://15000399146"
	beam.TextureMode = Enum.TextureMode.Wrap
	beam.TextureLength = 1
	beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
	beam.LightEmission = 1
	beam.FaceCamera = true
	beam.Parent = hand
	table.insert(webs, beam)
	table.insert(webs, handAtt)
end

local function attachArm(char, hum, side, targetAtt)
	local hand = getHand(char, side)
	local root = getArmRoot(char, side)
	if not hand or not root or not targetAtt then return end
	local ik = Instance.new("IKControl")
	ik.Name = "WebArmIK_" .. side
	ik.Type = Enum.IKControlType.Position
	ik.EndEffector = hand
	ik.ChainRoot = root
	ik.Target = targetAtt
	ik.Weight = 1
	ik.SmoothTime = 0.08
	ik.Parent = hum
	table.insert(ikList, ik)
end

local function getClimbSurface()
	local char, hrp = getParts()
	local params = RaycastParams.new()
	params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
	params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char }
	params.IgnoreWater = true

	local up = Workspace:Raycast(hrp.Position, Vector3.new(0, 4.8, 0), params)  
	if up and up.Normal.Y < -0.45 then  
		return up, "ceiling"  
	end  

	local flatLook = Vector3.new(hrp.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, hrp.CFrame.LookVector.Z)  
	if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.01 then  
		local lip = Workspace:Raycast(hrp.Position + Vector3.new(0, 1.4, 0), flatLook.Unit * 2.4 + Vector3.new(0, 3.2, 0), params)  
		if lip and lip.Normal.Y < -0.4 then  
			return lip, "ceiling"  
		end  
	end  

	local directions = {  
		hrp.CFrame.LookVector,  
		-hrp.CFrame.LookVector,  
		hrp.CFrame.RightVector,  
		-hrp.CFrame.RightVector,  
	}  
	local closestResult = nil  
	local closestDistance = math.huge  
	for _, direction in ipairs(directions) do  
		local result = Workspace:Raycast(hrp.Position, direction * 3.6, params)  
		if result and math.abs(result.Normal.Y) < 0.55 then  
			local distance = (result.Position - hrp.Position).Magnitude  
			if distance < closestDistance then  
				closestDistance = distance  
				closestResult = result  
			end  
		end  
	end  
	if closestResult then  
		return closestResult, "wall"  
	end  
	return nil, nil
end

local function stopClimb()
	if not climbing then return end
	climbing = false
	if climbConn then climbConn:Disconnect(); climbConn = nil end
	if climbTrack then
		if climbTrack.IsPlaying then climbTrack:Stop(0.15) end
		climbTrack = nil
	end
	if climbVelocity then climbVelocity:Destroy(); climbVelocity = nil end
	if climbAlign then climbAlign:Destroy(); climbAlign = nil end
	if climbAttachment then climbAttachment:Destroy(); climbAttachment = nil end
	local _, hrp, hum = getParts()
	hum.AutoRotate = true
	hum.PlatformStand = false
	hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
end

local function startClimb()
	if climbing or not climbEnabled then return end
	local _, hrp, hum = getParts()
	local wall = getClimbSurface()
	if not wall then return end
	climbing = true
	hum.AutoRotate = false
	hum.PlatformStand = false
	local animator = getAnimator(hum)
	local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
	anim.AnimationId = CLIMB_ANIM
	climbTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
	climbTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
	climbTrack.Looped = true
	climbTrack:Play(0.1)
	hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing)
	climbAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	climbAttachment.Name = "SpiderClimbAttachment"
	climbAttachment.Parent = hrp
	climbVelocity = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
	climbVelocity.Name = "SpiderClimbVelocity"
	climbVelocity.MaxForce = math.huge
	climbVelocity.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
	climbVelocity.VectorVelocity = Vector3.zero
	climbVelocity.Attachment0 = climbAttachment
	climbVelocity.Parent = hrp
	climbAlign = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
	climbAlign.Name = "SpiderClimbOrientation"
	climbAlign.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
	climbAlign.MaxTorque = math.huge
	climbAlign.Responsiveness = 30
	climbAlign.RigidityEnabled = false
	climbAlign.Attachment0 = climbAttachment
	climbAlign.Parent = hrp
	climbConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not climbing then return end
		if not hrp.Parent then stopClimb(); return end
		local surface, kind = getClimbSurface()
		if not surface then stopClimb(); return end
		local normal = surface.Normal
		local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
		local cameraForward = camera.CFrame.LookVector
		local cameraRight = camera.CFrame.RightVector
		local move = hum.MoveDirection
		if kind == "ceiling" then
			hum.PlatformStand = true
			local planar = Vector3.new(move.X, 0, move.Z)
			local speed = 0
			if planar.Magnitude > 0.08 then
				planar = planar.Unit
				speed = 12
			else
				planar = Vector3.new(cameraForward.X, 0, cameraForward.Z)
				if planar.Magnitude > 0.01 then
					planar = planar.Unit
				else
					planar = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
				end
			end
			climbVelocity.VectorVelocity = planar * speed + Vector3.new(0, 7, 0)
			climbAlign.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), planar)
		else
			hum.PlatformStand = false
			local horizontal = Vector3.new(move.X, 0, move.Z)
			local vertical = 0
			if horizontal.Magnitude > 0.05 then vertical = horizontal:Dot(cameraForward) end
			local up = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			local wallRight = cameraRight - normal * cameraRight:Dot(normal)
			if wallRight.Magnitude > 0.01 then wallRight = wallRight.Unit end
			climbVelocity.VectorVelocity = up * vertical * 9 + wallRight * move:Dot(wallRight) * 8 - normal * 4
			local facing = -normal
			local look = Vector3.new(facing.X, 0, facing.Z)
			if look.Magnitude > 0.01 then climbAlign.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, look.Unit) end
		end
		if hum:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing then hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing) end
	end)
end

	swingRope.Visible = false

		addWebFromHand(char, a0, "Left")

		attachArm(char, hum, "Left", a0)

		local dir = offset.Unit

local function createGroundWeb(position, normal)
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = "GroundWeb"
	part.Anchored = true
	part.CanCollide = false
	part.CanTouch = false
	part.CanQuery = false
	part.Transparency = 1
	part.Size = Vector3.new(7, 0.05, 7)
	local up = normal.Unit
	local forward = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	if math.abs(up:Dot(forward)) > 0.95 then forward = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0) end
	forward = (forward - up * forward:Dot(up)).Unit
	part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(position + up * 0.035, position + up * 0.035 + forward, up)
	part.Parent = Workspace
	local decal = Instance.new("Decal")
	decal.Texture = GROUND_WEB_TEXTURE
	decal.Face = Enum.NormalId.Top
	decal.Parent = part
	table.insert(webShotObjects, part)
	Debris:AddItem(part, 8)
end

local function fireWebProjectile(char, startPosition, direction)
	local projectile = Instance.new("Part")
	projectile.Name = "WebShotProjectile"
	projectile.Anchored = true
	projectile.CanCollide = false
	projectile.CanTouch = false
	projectile.CanQuery = false
	projectile.Transparency = 1
	projectile.Size = Vector3.new(0.35, 0.35, 0.35)
	projectile.Position = startPosition
	projectile.Parent = Workspace
	table.insert(webShotObjects, projectile)
	local frontAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	frontAttachment.Parent = projectile
	local webVisual = Instance.new("Part")
	webVisual.Name = "WebShotVisual"
	webVisual.Anchored = true
	webVisual.CanCollide = false
	webVisual.CanTouch = false
	webVisual.CanQuery = false
	webVisual.Transparency = 1
	webVisual.Size = Vector3.new(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
	webVisual.Position = startPosition - direction * 0.8
	webVisual.Parent = Workspace
	table.insert(webShotObjects, webVisual)
	local backAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	backAttachment.Parent = webVisual
	local beam = Instance.new("Beam")
	beam.Attachment0 = backAttachment
	beam.Attachment1 = frontAttachment
	beam.Width0 = 0.9
	beam.Width1 = 0.9
	beam.Texture = WEB_SHOT_TEXTURE
	beam.TextureMode = Enum.TextureMode.Wrap
	beam.TextureLength = 1
	beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255))
	beam.LightEmission = 1
	beam.FaceCamera = true
	beam.Segments = 4
	beam.Parent = webVisual
	table.insert(webShotObjects, beam)
	local velocity = direction.Unit * 75
	local position = startPosition
	local previousPosition = position
	local elapsed = 0
	local gravity = Vector3.new(0, -120, 0)
	local connection
	connection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		if not projectile.Parent then connection:Disconnect(); return end
		elapsed += dt
		velocity += gravity * dt
		previousPosition = position
		position += velocity * dt
		local params = RaycastParams.new()
		params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
		params.FilterDescendantsInstances = { char, projectile, webVisual }
		params.IgnoreWater = true
		local result = Workspace:Raycast(previousPosition, position - previousPosition, params)
		if result and result.Normal.Y > 0.45 then
			connection:Disconnect()
			projectile.Position = result.Position
			createGroundWeb(result.Position, result.Normal)
			projectile:Destroy()
			webVisual:Destroy()
			return
		end
		projectile.Position = position
		webVisual.Position = position - direction.Unit * 0.8
		if elapsed > 2.5 then
			connection:Disconnect()
			projectile:Destroy()
			webVisual:Destroy()
		end
	end)
end

local function playPunch(side)
	if punching then return end
	local char, hrp, hum = getParts()
	if hum.Health <= 0 then return end
	local generation = beginPunch(char, hum)
	local startTime = os.clock()
	local sign = side == "Right" and 1 or -1
	local other = side == "Right" and "Left" or "Right"
	local target = Instance.new("Attachment")
	target.Name = "SpiderAcrobaticPunchTarget"
	target.Parent = hrp
	table.insert(punchObjects, target)
	local hand = getHand(char, side)
	local root = getArmRoot(char, side)
	if hand and root then
		local ik = Instance.new("IKControl")
		ik.Name = "SpiderAcrobaticPunchIK_" .. side
		ik.Type = Enum.IKControlType.Position
		ik.EndEffector = hand
		ik.ChainRoot = root
		ik.Target = target
		ik.Weight = 1
		ik.SmoothTime = 0.045
		ik.Parent = hum
		table.insert(punchObjects, ik)
	end
	local spinAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	spinAttachment.Name = "SpiderPunchSpinAttachment"
	spinAttachment.Parent = hrp
	table.insert(punchObjects, spinAttachment)
	local spin = Instance.new("AngularVelocity")
	spin.Name = "SpiderPunchBodyTwist"
	spin.Attachment0 = spinAttachment
	spin.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
	spin.MaxTorque = 0
	spin.AngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
	spin.Parent = hrp
	table.insert(punchObjects, spin)
	hum.AutoRotate = false
	punchConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if generation ~= punchGeneration then return end
		if not char.Parent or not hrp.Parent or hum.Health <= 0 then
			clearPunch()
			return
		end
		local t = os.clock() - startTime
		if t < 0.12 then
			target.Position = Vector3.new(sign * 0.95, 0.15, 0.15)
			setMotor(char, "Waist", CFrame.Angles(math.rad(18), math.rad(-sign * 34), math.rad(sign * 10)))
			setMotor(char, side .. "Shoulder", CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-38), math.rad(sign * 35), math.rad(-sign * 78)))
			setMotor(char, side .. "Elbow", CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-105), 0, math.rad(sign * 8)))
			setMotor(char, other .. "Shoulder", CFrame.Angles(math.rad(35), math.rad(-sign * 18), math.rad(sign * 48)))
			setMotor(char, other .. "Elbow", CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-72), 0, 0))
			setMotor(char, "RightHip", CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-20), 0, math.rad(8)))
			setMotor(char, "LeftHip", CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-20), 0, math.rad(-8)))
			setMotor(char, "RightKnee", CFrame.Angles(math.rad(28), 0, 0))
			setMotor(char, "LeftKnee", CFrame.Angles(math.rad(28), 0, 0))
			spin.MaxTorque = 0
		elseif t < 0.23 then
			target.Position = Vector3.new(sign * 0.55, 0.55, -1.55)
			setMotor(char, "Waist", CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-8), math.rad(sign * 25), math.rad(-sign * 8)))
			setMotor(char, side .. "Shoulder", CFrame.Angles(math.rad(58), math.rad(sign * 18), math.rad(-sign * 22)))
			setMotor(char, side .. "Elbow", CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-42), 0, 0))
			setMotor(char, other .. "Shoulder", CFrame.Angles(math.rad(45), math.rad(-sign * 24), math.rad(sign * 38)))
			setMotor(char, other .. "Elbow", CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-82), 0, 0))

local function playKick()
	if punching then return end
	local char, hrp, hum = getParts()
	if hum.Health <= 0 then return end
	local generation = beginPunch(char, hum)
	hum.AutoRotate = false
	hum.PlatformStand = false
	local animator = getAnimator(hum)
	local anim = Instance.new("Animation")
	anim.AnimationId = "rbxassetid://133566007754001"
	kickTrack = animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
	kickTrack.Priority = Enum.AnimationPriority.Action4
	kickTrack.Looped = false
	kickTrack:Play(0.05)
	local length = kickTrack.Length
	if length <= 0 then
		length = 1.2
	end
	task.delay(length + 0.05, function()
		if generation ~= punchGeneration then return end
		clearPunch()
	end)
end

		playPunch("Right")
	elseif punchStep == 2 then

	end

end)

local function stopWebWing()
	if not webWing then return end
	webWing = false
	if webWingSound then
		webWingSound:Stop()
		webWingSound:Destroy()
		webWingSound = nil
	end
	if webWingConn then webWingConn:Disconnect(); webWingConn = nil end
	for _, ik in ipairs(webWingIK) do if ik and ik.Parent then ik:Destroy() end end
	table.clear(webWingIK)
	for _, obj in ipairs(webWingObjects) do if obj and obj.Parent then obj:Destroy() end end
	table.clear(webWingObjects)
	if webWingAlign then webWingAlign:Destroy(); webWingAlign = nil end
	if webWingAttachment then webWingAttachment:Destroy(); webWingAttachment = nil end
	if webWingRightHip and webWingRightHip.Parent then webWingRightHip.Transform = webWingRightHipOriginal or CFrame.identity end
	if webWingLeftHip and webWingLeftHip.Parent then webWingLeftHip.Transform = webWingLeftHipOriginal or CFrame.identity end
	webWingRightHip = nil
	webWingLeftHip = nil
	webWingRightHipOriginal = nil
	webWingLeftHipOriginal = nil
	webWingHeadLook = nil
	local char, _, hum = getParts()
	resetArmPose(char)
