local function startWebWing()
	if webWing then stopWebWing(); return end
	local char, hrp, hum = getParts()
	if hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air then return end
	webWing = true
	webWingSound = Instance.new("Sound")
	webWingSound.Name = "WebWingSound"
	webWingSound.SoundId = WEB_WING_SOUND
	webWingSound.Volume = 2
	webWingSound.Looped = true
	webWingSound.Parent = hrp
	webWingSound:Play()
	hum.AutoRotate = false
	hum.PlatformStand = true
	local rightArmTarget = createWebWingTarget(hrp, "WebWingRightArmTarget", Vector3.new(2.45, 0.35, 0.05))
	local leftArmTarget = createWebWingTarget(hrp, "WebWingLeftArmTarget", Vector3.new(-2.45, 0.35, 0.05))
	local rightUpperLeg = char:FindFirstChild("RightUpperLeg")
	local leftUpperLeg = char:FindFirstChild("LeftUpperLeg")
	if rightUpperLeg then
		local hip = rightUpperLeg:FindFirstChild("RightHip")
		if hip and hip:IsA("Motor6D") then webWingRightHip = hip; webWingRightHipOriginal = hip.Transform end
	end
	if leftUpperLeg then
		local hip = leftUpperLeg:FindFirstChild("LeftHip")
		if hip and hip:IsA("Motor6D") then webWingLeftHip = hip; webWingLeftHipOriginal = hip.Transform end
	end
	local rightHand = getHand(char, "Right")
	local rightArmRoot = getArmRoot(char, "Right")
	if rightHand and rightArmRoot then
		local ik = Instance.new("IKControl")
		ik.Name = "WebWingRightArmIK"
		ik.Type = Enum.IKControlType.Position
		ik.EndEffector = rightHand
		ik.ChainRoot = rightArmRoot
		ik.Target = rightArmTarget
		ik.Weight = 1
		ik.SmoothTime = 0.08
		ik.Parent = hum
		table.insert(webWingIK, ik)
	end
	local leftHand = getHand(char, "Left")
	local leftArmRoot = getArmRoot(char, "Left")
	if leftHand and leftArmRoot then
		local ik = Instance.new("IKControl")
		ik.Name = "WebWingLeftArmIK"
		ik.Type = Enum.IKControlType.Position
		ik.EndEffector = leftHand
		ik.ChainRoot = leftArmRoot
		ik.Target = leftArmTarget
		ik.Weight = 1
		ik.SmoothTime = 0.08
		ik.Parent = hum
		table.insert(webWingIK, ik)
	end
	createWebWingBeam(rightArmTarget, rightHand)
	createWebWingBeam(leftArmTarget, leftHand)
	webWingAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
	webWingAttachment.Name = "WebWingOrientation"
	webWingAttachment.Parent = hrp
	webWingAlign = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
	webWingAlign.Name = "WebWingAlign"
	webWingAlign.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
	webWingAlign.Attachment0 = webWingAttachment
	webWingAlign.MaxTorque = math.huge
	webWingAlign.Responsiveness = 20
	webWingAlign.RigidityEnabled = false
	webWingAlign.Parent = hrp
	local head = char:FindFirstChild("Head")
	local upper = char:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso")
	webWingHeadLook = Instance.new("Attachment")
	webWingHeadLook.Name = "WebWingHeadLook"
	webWingHeadLook.Parent = hrp
	table.insert(webWingObjects, webWingHeadLook)
	if head and upper then
		local ik = Instance.new("IKControl")
		ik.Name = "WebWingHeadIK"
		ik.Type = Enum.IKControlType.LookAt
		ik.EndEffector = head
		ik.ChainRoot = upper
		ik.Target = webWingHeadLook
		ik.Weight = 1
		ik.SmoothTime = 0.08
		ik.Parent = hum
		table.insert(webWingIK, ik)
	end
	webWingConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not webWing then return end
		if not hrp.Parent then stopWebWing(); return end
		local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not camera then return end
		local cameraLook = camera.CFrame.LookVector
		local forward = Vector3.new(cameraLook.X, 0, cameraLook.Z)
		if forward.Magnitude < 0.01 then return end
		forward = forward.Unit
		hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = forward * 55 + Vector3.new(0, -4, 0)
		webWingAlign.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.zero, Vector3.new(0, -1, 0), forward)
		poseWingArms(char)
		if webWingRightHip and webWingRightHip.Parent then
			webWingRightHip.Transform = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-18), math.rad(8), math.rad(8))
		end
		if webWingLeftHip and webWingLeftHip.Parent then
			webWingLeftHip.Transform = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-18), math.rad(-8), math.rad(-8))
		end
		if webWingHeadLook and webWingHeadLook.Parent and head then
			webWingHeadLook.WorldPosition = head.Position + forward * 10 + Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)
		end
	end)
end

local function releaseChargeJump()
	if not chargingJump then return end
	chargingJump = false
	if jumpChargeConn then
		jumpChargeConn:Disconnect()
		jumpChargeConn = nil
	end
	local _, hrp, hum = getParts()
	local power = 55 + jumpCharge * 130
	local look = Vector3.new(hrp.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, hrp.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
	if look.Magnitude < 0.01 then
		look = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	else
		look = look.Unit
	end
	hum.UseJumpPower = true
	hum.JumpPower = power
	hum.WalkSpeed = savedWalkSpeed
	hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
	hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = look * (20 + jumpCharge * 95) + Vector3.new(0, power * 0.78, 0)
	clearJumpBar()
	jumpCharge = 0
	task.delay(0.35, function()
		if hum and hum.Parent then
			hum.JumpPower = 100
		end
	end)
end

local function startChargeJump()
	if chargingJump then return end
	chargingJump = true
	jumpCharge = 0
	local _, _, hum = getParts()
	savedWalkSpeed = hum.WalkSpeed
	hum.WalkSpeed = savedWalkSpeed + 10
	ensureJumpBar()
	setJumpFill(0)
	local startTime = os.clock()
	jumpChargeConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
		if not chargingJump then return end
		jumpCharge = math.clamp((os.clock() - startTime) / 1.15, 0, 1)
		setJumpFill(jumpCharge)
	end)
end

local PASSWORD_HASH = {
    114, 111, 109, 97, 108, 32, 43, 114, 97, 114, 109, 122, 101, 32, 111, 110, 116, 111, 112
}

local function GetRealPassword()
    local s = ""
    for _, c in ipairs(PASSWORD_HASH) do
        s = s .. string.char(c)
    end
    return s
end

local function NormalizePassword(s)
    s = tostring(s or "")
    s = s:lower()
    s = s:gsub("%c", "")
    s = s:gsub("\194\160", "")
    s = s:gsub("\226\128\139", "")
    s = s:gsub("\226\128\140", "")
    s = s:gsub("\226\128\141", "")
    s = s:gsub("\226\128\142", "")
    s = s:gsub("\226\128\143", "")
    s = s:gsub("\239\187\191", "")
    s = s:gsub("%s+", " ")
    s = s:gsub("^ ", "")
    s = s:gsub(" $", "")
    return s
end

local function UpdateMyBadge()
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    if not myChar then return end
    local head = myChar:FindFirstChild("Head") or myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not head then return end

    local badge = GetBadgeFromCharacter(myChar)
    if not ShowMyBadge then
        if badge then badge.Enabled = false end
        return
    end
    if not badge then
        badge = CreateBadge(head, true)
    end

    badge.Enabled = true
    if MyLevel >= 999 then
        badge.Label.Text = "🏆 Lv 999 (الأقصى!)"
    else
        badge.Label.Text = "⭐ Lv "..MyLevel.." • "..MyHelps.."/"..GetLevelTarget(MyLevel)
    end
end

local function UpdateOthersBadges()
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr.Character then
            local head = plr.Character:FindFirstChild("Head") or plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if head then
                local badge = GetBadgeFromCharacter(plr.Character)
                if not ShowOthersBadge then
                    if badge then badge:Destroy() end
                else
                    if not badge then
                        badge = CreateBadge(head, false)
                    end
                    local data = GetOrCreateLevelData(plr)
                    badge.Label.Text = "⭐ "..plr.Name.." • Lv "..data.level.." • "..data.helps.."/"..GetLevelTarget(data.level)
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

local function RefreshLevelUI()
    local target = GetLevelTarget(MyLevel)
    if MyLevel >= 999 then
        if LevelHeaderBtn then
            LevelHeaderBtn.Text = "🏆 المستوى: 999 (الأقصى!)"
        end
        if LevelBar then
            LevelBar.Set(1, "وصلت إلى أقصى مستوى!")
        end
    else
        if LevelHeaderBtn then
            LevelHeaderBtn.Text = "⭐ المستوى: "..MyLevel.." • المساعدات: "..MyHelps.."/"..target
        end
        if LevelBar then
            local frac = 0
            if target > 0 then frac = MyHelps / target end
            if frac > 1 then frac = 1 end
            LevelBar.Set(frac, MyHelps.." / "..target.." نحو المستوى "..(MyLevel + 1))
        end
    end
    UpdateMyBadge()
end

local function AddHelpForPlayer(plr, amount)
    if amount <= 0 then return end
    if plr == LocalPlayer then
        if MyLevel >= 999 then
            if not maxLevelNotified then
                maxLevelNotified = true
                NotifyMsg("rescue", "🏆 أقصى مستوى!", "وصلت إلى المستوى 999 - الحد الأقصى!", 8)
            end
            return
        end
        MyHelps = MyHelps + amount
        local target = GetLevelTarget(MyLevel)
        while MyHelps >= target and MyLevel < 999 do
            MyHelps = MyHelps - target
            MyLevel = MyLevel + 1
            NotifyMsg("rescue", "🎉 ترقية المستوى!", "ارتفعت إلى المستوى "..MyLevel.." ⭐ • الهدف القادم: "..GetLevelTarget(MyLevel).." مساعدة", 6)
            target = GetLevelTarget(MyLevel)
        end
        if MyLevel >= 999 then
            MyHelps = 0
            if not maxLevelNotified then
                maxLevelNotified = true
                NotifyMsg("rescue", "🏆 أقصى مستوى!", "وصلت إلى المستوى 999 - الحد الأقصى!", 8)
            end
        end
        SaveMyLevel()
        RefreshLevelUI()
        print("[⭐ نقطة لك!] المستوى "..MyLevel.." • التقدم "..MyHelps.."/"..GetLevelTarget(MyLevel))
    else
        local data = GetOrCreateLevelData(plr)
        if data.level >= 999 then return end
        data.helps = data.helps + amount
        local target = GetLevelTarget(data.level)
        while data.helps >= target and data.level < 999 do
            data.helps = data.helps - target
            data.level = data.level + 1
            NotifyMsg("info", "🎉 ترقية "..plr.Name.."!", "وصل إلى المستوى "..data.level.." ⭐", 4)
            target = GetLevelTarget(data.level)
        end
        if data.level >= 999 then data.helps = 0 end
        UpdateOthersBadges()
        print("[⭐ نقطة لـ "..plr.Name.."] المستوى "..data.level.." • التقدم "..data.helps.."/"..target)
    end
end

--═════════ كشف الساقطين ═════════--
local function ParseTimerText(text)
    if text == nil then return nil end
    local t = tostring(text):gsub("%s+", "")
    if t == "" or #t > 6 then return nil end
    local n = tonumber(t)
    if n and n > 0 and n <= 99 then return n end
    local m, s = t:match("^(%d+):(%d+)$")
    if m and s then
        local total = tonumber(m) * 60 + tonumber(s)
        if total > 0 and total <= 99 then return total end
    end
    return nil
end

local function IsActuallyVisible(obj)
    local current = obj
    local steps = 0
    while current and steps < 12 do
        if current:IsA("BillboardGui") or current:IsA("SurfaceGui") or current:IsA("ScreenGui") then
            if not current.Enabled then return false end
        elseif current:IsA("GuiObject") then
            if not current.Visible then return false end
        else
            break
        end
        current = current.Parent
        steps = steps + 1
    end
    return true
end

local DownedConfirm = {}

local function GetDownedInfo(player)
    local char = player.Character
    if not char or not char.Parent then
        DownedConfirm[player] = nil
        return nil
    end

    for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton") then
            local anc = d:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("BillboardGui")
                or d:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("SurfaceGui")
            if anc and IsActuallyVisible(d) then
                local num = ParseTimerText(d.Text)
                if num then return num end
            end
        end
    end

    local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if hum and root then
        local vel = root.AssemblyLinearVelocity
        local horizontal = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z).Magnitude
        if horizontal > 5 and hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Running and not hum.PlatformStand then
            DownedConfirm[player] = nil
            return nil
        end
    end

    for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and d.Enabled then
            return 999
        end
    end

    local iAmFollowing = (player == LocalPlayer) and followActive
    if hum and hum.Health > 0 and (hum.PlatformStand or hum:GetState() == Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics) then
        if not iAmFollowing then
            DownedConfirm[player] = DownedConfirm[player] or os.clock()
            if os.clock() - DownedConfirm[player] >= 1.2 then
                return 999
            end
        end
    else
        if not iAmFollowing then DownedConfirm[player] = nil end
    end

    return nil
end

--═════════ أدوات الضفدع والأرض ═════════--
local function GetFrogRoot()
    if not FrogPlayer then return nil end
    local char = FrogPlayer.Character
    if not char then return nil end
    return char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function IsFrogNear(pos, radius)
    local root = GetFrogRoot()
    if not root then return false end
    return (root.Position - pos).Magnitude < radius
end

local function GetRayParams()
    local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
    rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
    local exclude = {}
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr.Character then table.insert(exclude, plr.Character) end
    end
    rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = exclude
    return rayParams
end

local function RestoreCollision()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    if character then
        for _, part in pairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart"
            and not part.Parent:IsA("Accessory") then
                part.CanCollide = true
            end
        end
    end
end

--═════════ 🔘 الاندماج (اختياري - مطفي افتراضياً) ═════════--
local FOLLOW_OFFSET = -0.3

local function GetFollowCFrame(tRoot)
    local pos = tRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, FOLLOW_OFFSET, 0)
    return CFrame.new(pos) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(-90), 0, 0)
end

local function StopFollow()
    if followConn then followConn:Disconnect() followConn = nil end
    local wasActive = followActive
    followActive = false
    followTarget = nil
    followManual = false

    if wasActive then
        pcall(function()
            local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
            local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if myRoot then
                myRoot.Anchored = false
            end
        end)
        if not States.Noclip then pcall(RestoreCollision) end
    end
end

local lastFollowCheck = 0

local function StartFollow(target, manual)
    StopFollow()
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local tChar = target.Character
    local tRoot = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not (myRoot and tRoot) then return false end

    pcall(function()
        myRoot.Anchored = true
        for _, part in pairs(myChar:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CanCollide = false end
        end
        myRoot.CFrame = GetFollowCFrame(tRoot)
    end)

    followTarget = target
    followManual = manual and true or false
    followActive = true

    followConn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        local mChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local mRoot = mChar and mChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local mHum = mChar and mChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local tc = followTarget and followTarget.Character
        local tRoot2 = tc and tc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

        if not (mRoot and mHum and tRoot2) or mHum.Health <= 0 then
            StopFollow() return
        end
        if not mRoot.Anchored then mRoot.Anchored = true end

        if os.clock() - lastFollowCheck > 0.35 then
            lastFollowCheck = os.clock()
            if GetDownedInfo(followTarget) == nil then
                StopFollow()
                return
            end
            if States.Fly then StopFollow() return end
            if GetDownedInfo(LocalPlayer) ~= nil then StopFollow() return end
            if not followManual then
                if not States.Underground then StopFollow() return end
                if not (States.AutoTP or States.AutoRevive) then StopFollow() return end
            end
        end

        pcall(function()
            for _, part in pairs(mChar:GetDescendants()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") and part.CanCollide then part.CanCollide = false end
            end
        end)

        mRoot.CFrame = GetFollowCFrame(tRoot2)
    end)
    return true
end

--═════════ 🛡️ الهروب الآمن ═════════--
local lastSafePos = nil

local function FindSafeFlatSpot(centerPos, searchRadii, frogPos, minFrogDist)
    local rayParams = GetRayParams()
    local angles = {0, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 210, 240, 270, 300, 330}
    local bestSpot, bestFrogDist = nil, 0

    for _, r in ipairs(searchRadii) do
        for _, a in ipairs(angles) do
            local ok, result = pcall(function()
                local rad = math.rad(a)
                local candidateX = centerPos.X + math.cos(rad) * r
                local candidateZ = centerPos.Z + math.sin(rad) * r
                local fromY = centerPos.Y + 80

                local hit = Workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(candidateX, fromY, candidateZ), Vector3.new(0, -250, 0), rayParams)
                if not hit then return nil end
                local groundY = hit.Position.Y

                local flat = true
                local checks = {{2, 0}, {-2, 0}, {0, 2}, {0, -2}}
                for _, ck in ipairs(checks) do
                    local h2 = Workspace:Raycast(Vector3.new(candidateX + ck[1], fromY, candidateZ + ck[2]), Vector3.new(0, -250, 0), rayParams)
                    if not h2 then flat = false break end
                    if math.abs(h2.Position.Y - groundY) > 2.5 then flat = false break end
                end
                if not flat then return nil end

                return Vector3.new(candidateX, groundY + 3.5, candidateZ)
            end)

            if ok and result then
                if frogPos then
                    local fd = (Vector3.new(result.X, 0, result.Z) - Vector3.new(frogPos.X, 0, frogPos.Z)).Magnitude
                    if fd >= minFrogDist and fd > bestFrogDist then
                        bestSpot, bestFrogDist = result, fd
                    end
                else
                    return result
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return bestSpot
end

local function EscapeFromFrog()
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local fRoot = GetFrogRoot()
    if not (myRoot and fRoot) then return false end

    if lastSafePos then
        local currentFrog = GetFrogRoot()
        if not currentFrog or (currentFrog.Position - lastSafePos).Magnitude > DANGER_RADIUS + 15 then
            pcall(function()
                myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(lastSafePos)
            end)
            return true
        end
    end

    local spot = FindSafeFlatSpot(myRoot.Position, {70, 45}, fRoot.Position, DANGER_RADIUS + 10)
    if spot then
        pcall(function()
            myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(spot)
        end)
        return true
    end

    spot = FindSafeFlatSpot(myRoot.Position, {70, 45}, fRoot.Position, 25)
    if spot then
        pcall(function()
            myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(spot)
        end)
        return true
    end

    local bestHelper, bestDist = nil, 0
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr ~= FrogPlayer then
            local c = plr.Character
            local hum = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local root = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root and hum and hum.Health > 0 then
                local fd = (root.Position - fRoot.Position).Magnitude
                if fd > DANGER_RADIUS and fd > bestDist then
                    bestHelper, bestDist = plr, fd
                end
            end
        end
    end
    if bestHelper then
        local hRoot = bestHelper.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if hRoot then
            pcall(function()
                myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(hRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
            end)
            return true
        end
    end

    if lastSafePos then
        pcall(function()
            myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(lastSafePos)
        end)
        return true
    end

    print("[FroggeHub] ⚠️ لم أجد مكاناً آمناً - لم أنتقل (أمان)")
    return false
end

--═════════ 💚 الإحياء ═════════--
local function DoRevive(target)
    local char = target.Character
    if not char then return end

    local prompt
    for _, d in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
        if d:IsA("ProximityPrompt") and d.Enabled then
            prompt = d
            break
        end
    end

    if prompt then
        pcall(function()
            if fireproximityprompt then fireproximityprompt(prompt) end
        end)
        pcall(function()
            if prompt.HoldDuration and prompt.HoldDuration > 0 then
                prompt:InputHoldBegin()
                task.wait(math.min(prompt.HoldDuration, 4) + 0.2)
                prompt:InputHoldEnd()
            end
        end)
    end

    pcall(function()
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(true, REVIVE_KEY, false, game)
    end)

    local t0 = os.clock()
    local taps = 0
    while os.clock() - t0 < E_HOLD_MAX do
        task.wait(0.15)
        taps = taps + 1

        if GetDownedInfo(target) == nil then
            creditedByMe[target] = true
            Stats.reviveSuccess = Stats.reviveSuccess + 1
            NotifyMsg("rescue", "💚 إحياء ناجح!", "أحييت "..target.Name.." - النقاط توزع عند قيامه ⭐", 3)
            break
        end
        if GetDownedInfo(LocalPlayer) ~= nil then break end

        local tChar = target.Character
        local tRoot = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        local mChar = LocalPlayer.Character
        local mRoot = mChar and mChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if tRoot and mRoot then
            local d = (tRoot.Position - mRoot.Position).Magnitude
            if not followActive then
                if IsFrogNear(tRoot.Position, GUARD_RADIUS) then break end
                if d > 8 then
                    pcall(function()
                        mRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(tRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))
                    end)
                end
                if d > 25 then break end
            end
        else
            break
        end

        if prompt and taps % 10 == 0 then
            pcall(function()
                if fireproximityprompt then fireproximityprompt(prompt) end
            end)
        end
    end

    pcall(function()
        VirtualInputManager:SendKeyEvent(false, REVIVE_KEY, false, game)
    end)
end

local function SafeRevive(target)
    IsReviving = true
    pcall(DoRevive, target)
    IsReviving = false
end

local function GetBestHelperPlayer()
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return nil end

    local best, bestDist = nil, math.huge
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr ~= FrogPlayer then
            local c = plr.Character
            local hum = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local root = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if root and hum and hum.Health > 0 and GetDownedInfo(plr) == nil then
                local d = (root.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
                if not IsFrogNear(root.Position, DANGER_RADIUS + 10) then
                    if d < bestDist then best, bestDist = plr, d end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function TeleportToHelperForRescue()
    local helper = GetBestHelperPlayer()
    if not helper then return false, nil end
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local hChar = helper.Character
    local hRoot = hChar and hChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not (myRoot and hRoot) then return false, nil end

    pcall(function()
        myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(hRoot.Position + hRoot.CFrame.LookVector * 2.5 + Vector3.new(0, 1.5, 0))
    end)
    return true, helper
end

--═════════ 🚀 الانتقال السريع ═════════--
local lastManualTP = 0

local function GetBestRescueTarget()
    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not myRoot then return nil end

    local best, bestNum, bestDist = nil, math.huge, math.huge
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr ~= FrogPlayer then
            local num = GetDownedInfo(plr)
            if num then
                local tRoot = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                local guarded = tRoot and IsFrogNear(tRoot.Position, GUARD_RADIUS)
                if not guarded and tRoot then
                    local dist = (myRoot.Position - tRoot.Position).Magnitude
                    if num < bestNum or (num == bestNum and dist < bestDist) then
                        best, bestNum, bestDist = plr, num, dist
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return best
end

local function ManualTeleport(fromButton, skipIfClose)
    if os.clock() - lastManualTP < 0.6 then return end

    local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
    local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    local myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if not (myRoot and myHum and myHum.Health > 0) then return end
    if GetDownedInfo(LocalPlayer) then return end

    local best = GetBestRescueTarget()
    if not best then
        if fromButton then
            NotifyMsg("info", "🚀 الانتقال السريع", "لا يوجد لاعب ساقط حالياً 👀", 2)
        end
        return
    end

    if skipIfClose then
        local tRoot = best.Character and best.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if tRoot and (tRoot.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude < 12 then
            return
        end
    end

    if followActive and followManual and followTarget == best then
        if fromButton then
            NotifyMsg("info", "🚀 الانتقال السريع", "أنت ترافقه بالفعل 💚", 2)
        end
        return
    end

    lastManualTP = os.clock()
    local dist = GetPlayersDistance(LocalPlayer, best)
    local distTxt = dist and (" • كانت المسافة "..FormatDistance(dist)) or ""
    if States.Underground then
        if StartFollow(best, true) then
            Stats.rescues = Stats.rescues + 1
            NotifyMsg("rescue", "🚀 اندماج ومرافقة", "تم نقلك إلى داخل جسد "..best.Name..distTxt.." - سأبقى معه حتى يستيقظ", 3)
        end
    else
        local tChar = best.Character
        local tRoot = tChar and tChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if tRoot and myRoot then
            pcall(function()
                myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(tRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))
            end)
            Stats.rescues = Stats.rescues + 1
            NotifyMsg("rescue", "🚀 انتقال سريع", "تم نقلك فوق "..best.Name..distTxt.." (واقف)", 2)
        end
    end
end

local announcedDown = {}
local guardAnnounced = {}
local currentTarget = nil
local selfDownNotified = false
local lastHelpMeTP = 0
local lastEscapeAttempt = 0
local lastWarnTime = 0
local StatusFlags = { danger = 0, guardName = nil, helpme = false, warned = false }

task.spawn(function()
    while ScreenGui.Parent do
        task.wait(0.2)
        pcall(function()
            local myChar = LocalPlayer.Character
            local myHum = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local myRoot = myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            if not (myRoot and myHum) then return end

            StatusFlags.helpme = false
            StatusFlags.guardName = nil

            if myHum.Health <= 0 then return end

            -- ⓪ تنبيه مسبق (20م)
            if States.SelfEscape and not followActive then
                local fRootNow = GetFrogRoot()
                if fRootNow then
                    local dw = (fRootNow.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
                    if dw < WARN_RADIUS and dw >= DANGER_RADIUS then
                        if os.clock() - lastWarnTime > 10 then
                            lastWarnTime = os.clock()
                            Stats.warnings = Stats.warnings + 1
                            StatusFlags.warned = true
                            NotifyMsg("danger", "⚠️ الضفدع يقرّب!", "على "..FormatDistance(dw).." منك - استعد للهروب", 3)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end

            -- ① الهروب (10م فقط!)
            if States.SelfEscape and not followActive then
                local fRootNow = GetFrogRoot()
                if fRootNow then
                    local d = (fRootNow.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
                    if d < DANGER_RADIUS then
                        if os.clock() - lastEscapeAttempt > ESCAPE_COOLDOWN then
                            lastEscapeAttempt = os.clock()
                            StatusFlags.danger = os.clock()
                            local escaped = EscapeFromFrog()
                            if escaped then
                                Stats.escapes = Stats.escapes + 1
                                NotifyMsg("danger", "🛡️ هروب تلقائي!", "الضفدع اقترب منك ("..FormatDistance(d)..") - تم نقلك إلى مكان آمن 🏃", 3)
                            end
                        end
                        return
                    end
                end
            end

            -- ② أنا ساقط؟
            local myInfo = GetDownedInfo(LocalPlayer)
            if myInfo then
                StatusFlags.helpme = true
                if followActive then StopFollow() end
                if not selfDownNotified then
                    selfDownNotified = true
                    currentTarget = nil
                    NotifyMsg("rescue", "😴 لقد سقطت!", "ستتم محاولة نقلك إلى أقرب لاعب سليم 💚", 5)
                end
                if (States.AutoTP or States.AutoRevive) and os.clock() - lastHelpMeTP > 2 then
                    lastHelpMeTP = os.clock()
                    local ok, helper = TeleportToHelperForRescue()
                    if ok and helper then
                        local d = GetPlayersDistance(LocalPlayer, helper)
                        local dTxt = d and (" • على "..FormatDistance(d)) or ""
                        NotifyMsg("rescue", "😴 تم نقلك", "أنت الآن بجوار "..helper.Name..dTxt.." - اطلب منه إحياءك!", 4)
                    end
                end
                return
            end
            selfDownNotified = false

            -- ③ كشف الساقطين + النقاط
            local downed = {}
            for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if plr ~= LocalPlayer and plr ~= FrogPlayer then
                    local num = GetDownedInfo(plr)
                    if num then
                        local tRoot = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        local guarded = tRoot and IsFrogNear(tRoot.Position, GUARD_RADIUS)
                        if guarded then
                            if not guardAnnounced[plr] then
                                guardAnnounced[plr] = true
                                NotifyMsg("rescue", "⏳ الضفدع يحرس "..plr.Name, "ننتظر ابتعاده...", 3)
                            end
                            StatusFlags.guardName = plr.Name
                            if currentTarget == plr then currentTarget = nil end
                        else
                            downed[plr] = num
                            if guardAnnounced[plr] then
                                guardAnnounced[plr] = nil
                                NotifyMsg("rescue", "💨 ابتعد الضفدع عن "..plr.Name, "بإمكاننا إنقاذه الآن! 🏃", 3)
                            end
                            if not announcedDown[plr] then
                                announcedDown[plr] = {t = os.clock(), char = plr.Character}
                                local d = GetPlayersDistance(LocalPlayer, plr)
                                local dTxt = d and (" • على "..FormatDistance(d)) or ""
                                local timerTxt = (num <= 99) and (" • المتبقي: "..math.floor(num).." ثانية") or ""
                                NotifyMsg("rescue", "🚨 سقوط: "..plr.Name, "وقع اللاعب"..dTxt..timerTxt.." 🏃", 3)
                            end

                            if tRoot then
                                downedHelpers[plr] = downedHelpers[plr] or {}
                                for _, other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                                    if other ~= plr and other ~= FrogPlayer then
                                        local oc = other.Character
                                        local oroot = oc and oc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                                        if oroot then
                                            local dd = (oroot.Position - tRoot.Position).Magnitude
                                            if dd < HELPER_RADIUS then
                                                downedHelpers[plr][other] = os.clock()
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    else
                        local info = announcedDown[plr]
                        announcedDown[plr] = nil
                        guardAnnounced[plr] = nil
                        if info and os.clock() - info.t > 1.5 then
                            local c = plr.Character
                            local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                            if h and h.Health > 0 and info.char == c then
                                local helpers = downedHelpers[plr] or {}
                                if creditedByMe[plr] then
                                    helpers[LocalPlayer] = os.clock()
                                    creditedByMe[plr] = nil
                                end
                                local tRoot = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                                if tRoot then
                                    for _, other in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                                        if other ~= plr and other ~= FrogPlayer then
                                            local oc = other.Character
                                            local oroot = oc and oc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                                            if oroot then
                                                local dd = (oroot.Position - tRoot.Position).Magnitude
                                                if dd < HELPER_RADIUS then
                                                    helpers[other] = os.clock()
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                                local count = 0
                                local names = {}
                                for helper, lastSeen in pairs(helpers) do
                                    if os.clock() - lastSeen < HELPER_FRESH then
                                        AddHelpForPlayer(helper, 1)
                                        count = count + 1
                                        table.insert(names, helper.Name)
                                    end
                                end
                                if count > 1 then
                                    NotifyMsg("rescue", "🌟 إحياء جماعي! +"..count.." نقاط", "استيقظ "..plr.Name.." بمساعدة "..count.." لاعبين: "..table.concat(names, "، "), 5)
                                elseif count == 1 then
                                    NotifyMsg("rescue", "⭐ إحياء ناجح! +1", "استيقظ "..plr.Name.." • المساعد: "..names[1], 4)
                                else
                                    NotifyMsg("rescue", "💚 استيقظ "..plr.Name, "تعافى من السقوط", 2)
                                end
                            elseif info.char ~= c then
                                NotifyMsg("rescue", "💀 للأسف", "انتهى وقت "..plr.Name.."...", 2)
                            end
                        end
                        downedHelpers[plr] = nil
                    end
                end
            end

            -- ④ أفعال الإنقاذ
            if not (States.AutoTP or States.AutoRevive) then
                if followActive and not followManual then StopFollow() end
                currentTarget = nil
                return
            end

            if currentTarget and not downed[currentTarget] then
                currentTarget = nil
            end
            if not currentTarget then
                local bestNum = math.huge
                for plr, num in pairs(downed) do
                    if num < bestNum then
                        bestNum = num
                        currentTarget = plr
                    end
                end
            end

            if currentTarget then
                local theirChar = currentTarget.Character
                local theirRoot = theirChar and theirChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

                if theirRoot and myRoot then
                    if States.Underground then
                        if not followActive or followTarget ~= currentTarget then
                            if StartFollow(currentTarget, false) then
                                Stats.rescues = Stats.rescues + 1
                                local d = GetPlayersDistance(LocalPlayer, currentTarget)
                                local dTxt = d and (" • على "..FormatDistance(d)) or ""
                                NotifyMsg("rescue", "🔘 اندماج", "تم الدمج مع جسد "..currentTarget.Name..dTxt.." - سأبقى معه حتى يستيقظ", 3)
                            end
                        end
                        if States.AutoRevive then
                            SafeRevive(currentTarget)
                        end
                    else
                        -- الانتقال واقف (بلا دمج)
                        local dist = (theirRoot.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude
                        if States.AutoTP and dist > 9 then
                            pcall(function()
                                myRoot.CFrame = CFrame.new(theirRoot.Position + Vector3.new(0, 2.5, 0))
                            end)
                        end
                        if States.AutoRevive and dist <= 15 then
                            if not IsFrogNear(myRoot.Position, DANGER_RADIUS) then
                                SafeRevive(currentTarget)
                            end
                        end
                    end
                else
                    currentTarget = nil
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end)

local function StartFly()
    local character = LocalPlayer.Character
    local rootPart = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not rootPart then return end

    local bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
    bodyVelocity.Name = "FroggeHub_Fly"
    bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new()
    bodyVelocity.Parent = rootPart

    local bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
    bodyGyro.Name = "FroggeHub_Gyro"
    bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
    bodyGyro.P = 9000
    bodyGyro.D = 500
    bodyGyro.Parent = rootPart

    task.spawn(function()
        while States.Fly and ScreenGui.Parent do
            RunService.RenderStepped:Wait()
            local currentChar = LocalPlayer.Character
            local currentRoot = currentChar and currentChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local humanoid = currentChar and currentChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera
            if currentRoot and humanoid and camera then
                if bodyVelocity.Parent ~= currentRoot then
                    bodyVelocity.Parent = currentRoot
                    bodyGyro.Parent = currentRoot
                end
                bodyGyro.CFrame = camera.CFrame
                local velocity = humanoid.MoveDirection * FlySpeed
                if FlyUp then velocity = velocity + Vector3.new(0, FlySpeed, 0) end
                if FlyDown then velocity = velocity - Vector3.new(0, FlySpeed, 0) end
                bodyVelocity.Velocity = velocity
            end
        end
        bodyVelocity:Destroy()
        bodyGyro:Destroy()
    end)
end

scripts.script:
-- Delta Shotgun Fling Tool Script (Permanent Deletion + Infinite Debris Tracking)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Mouse = LocalPlayer:GetMouse()
local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

-- 1. Create the Shotgun Tool Container
local Shotgun = Instance.new("Tool")
Shotgun.Name = "💥 Delta Infinite Destroyer"
Shotgun.RequiresHandle = true

-- 2. Create the Visual Handle for the Gun
local Handle = Instance.new("Part")
Handle.Name = "Handle"
Handle.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.8, 3.5)
Handle.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Really black")
Handle.Material = Enum.Material.Metal
Handle.Parent = Shotgun

local Sound = Instance.new("Sound")
Sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://131070686"
Sound.Volume = 1
Sound.Parent = Handle

-- Laser Pointer Trail
local LaserAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment", Handle)
LaserAttachment.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1.75)

local Beam = Instance.new("Beam")
Beam.Width0 = 0.05
Beam.Width1 = 0.05
Beam.Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0))
Beam.FaceCamera = true
Beam.Enabled = false
Beam.Parent = Handle

local MouseTargetAttachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
MouseTargetAttachment.Parent = workspace:WaitForChild("Terrain")

Shotgun.Equipped:Connect(function()
    Beam.Enabled = true
    task.spawn(function()
        while Beam.Enabled do
            MouseTargetAttachment.Position = Mouse.Hit.p
            Beam.Attachment0 = LaserAttachment
            Beam.Attachment1 = MouseTargetAttachment
            task.wait()
        end
    end)
end)

Shotgun.Unequipped:Connect(function()
    Beam.Enabled = false
end)

-- 3. Destruction & Fling Mechanics
Shotgun.Activated:Connect(function()
    local Target = Mouse.Target
    if not Target or Target == workspace.Terrain then return end
    
    Sound:Play()
    local MyRoot = LocalPlayer.Character and LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if not MyRoot then return end
    
    local LookDirection = (Mouse.Hit.p - MyRoot.Position).Unit
    local ImpactPosition = Mouse.Hit.p

    -- --- EXPLOSION EFFECT ---
    local Exp = Instance.new("Explosion")
    Exp.BlastRadius = 0 
    Exp.BlastPressure = 0 
    Exp.Position = ImpactPosition
    Exp.Parent = workspace

    -- --- CHECK IF TARGET IS A PLAYER ---
    local Character = Target:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")
    local Humanoid = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    
    if Humanoid and Character ~= LocalPlayer.Character then
        local RootPart = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or Character:FindFirstChild("Torso")
        if RootPart then
            RootPart.Anchored = true
            for _, part in pairs(Character:GetChildren()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.BrickColor = BrickColor.new("Bright red") end
            end
            
            task.wait(0.15)
            RootPart.Anchored = false
            
            local Velocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
            Velocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e7, 1e7, 1e7)
            Velocity.Velocity = (LookDirection * 500) + Vector3.new(0, 350, 0) 
            Velocity.Parent = RootPart
            Debris:AddItem(Velocity, 0.15)
        end
        
    -- --- IF TARGET IS A MAP PROP (NEVER DISAPPEAR) ---
    elseif not Target:IsDescendantOf(LocalPlayer.Character) and Target.Name ~= "Baseplate" then
        local TargetProp = Target
        if Target.Parent and Target.Parent ~= workspace and not Target.Parent:IsA("Folder") then
            TargetProp = Target.Parent
        end
        
        -- Clone the prop to turn it into physical, flying debris
        local PropClone = TargetProp:Clone()
        if PropClone then
            if PropClone:IsA("BasePart") then
                PropClone.Anchored = false
                PropClone.CanCollide = true
            else
                for _, part in pairs(PropClone:GetDescendants()) do
                    if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                        part.Anchored = false
                        part.CanCollide = true
                    end
                end
            end
            
            local PropRoot = PropClone:IsA("BasePart") and PropClone or PropClone:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
            if PropRoot then
                PropClone.Parent = workspace
                
                -- Instantly wipe the original map position forever
                TargetProp:Destroy() 
                
                -- Yeet the debris clone into the world
                local PropVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
                PropVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e8, 1e8, 1e8)
                PropVelocity.Velocity = (LookDirection * 600) + Vector3.new(0, 300, 0)
                PropVelocity.Parent = PropRoot
                
                -- Clean up the velocity object itself quickly so the object rolls naturally
                Debris:AddItem(PropVelocity, 0.2) 
                
                -- NOTE: The PropClone itself is NEVER removed. It will clutter the ground forever.
            end
        end
    end
end)

Shotgun.Parent = LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("Backpack")

scripts.features:
A quality-of-life + PvP pack for this facility. Light on FPS, and almost
everything is OFF by default - only the ESP starts enabled, so nothing that
touches the server runs unless you turn it on.

ESP
- HOSTILE tag ESP: reads the game's own wanted/hostile tag, so only players the
  game marks hostile are highlighted (red), with name, @login, distance and HP.
- Show all players, door ESP, and Scavenger Hunt pumpkin ESP.
- Player names are drawn in their team colour.

AIM
- Taser silent aim: corrects the local hit-test ray while the taser activates.
- Taser Rifle aim lives in the Experimental tab (35 degree cap, misses often).

VISUAL / PRIVACY
- Fullbright loop with a brightness slider and a combo hotkey (default Y).
- Hide every player name (leaderboards stay readable) and hide avatars, clothes,
  accessories, exoskeleton pieces and glow effects. Weapons stay visible.
  Everything reverts cleanly.
- Anti-AFK.

AUTOMATION
- Auto interact: pick up, sit, search, food, doors - per-category toggles, radius
  slider, optional tap-to-complete.
- Auto mop spills with wall routing (goes around glass walls and furniture).
- Separate auto door opening with its own cooldown.
- On-screen countdown HUD (event / heist / combat), draggable anywhere.
- Quick reset hotkey, default Z, combos supported.

TARGET
- Angry target ESP for one or many players: name size, colour, highlight strength.
- Target card: auto-skip until it offers the player you want.

JOB
- Sub-team change from the panel. The server only allows switching inside your
  current team, so cross-team changes are refused by the game itself.

EXPERIMENTAL
- The buggy ones live here on purpose. Use at your own risk.

KEY
Free. A key is required and cached, so you enter it once. Press "Get key" in the gate.

NOTES
- Press "Unload script" before loading a new version.
